	support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare = function(owner, action, target_darken, duration)
		--- 오너와 액션이 있어야 함
		if not owner or not action then
			return
		end

		--- 필드가 없다면 생략함
		if not field then
			return
		end

		local time_mod = 1

		--- 콜로세움에서는 내 파티 캐릭터, 적 파티 캐릭터 둘 다 슬로우 된다.
		if stage_mode_util.is_colosseum() then
			time_mod = 0.3
		--- 멀티 플레이 컨텐츠이고 유저 파티에 속하지 않은 경우
		elseif stage_mode_util.is_coop() or stage_mode_util.is_guild_castle() or not party_util.is_in_user_party(owner) then
			--- 메뉴얼 로컬이 아니면 생략함
			if not battle_util.is_manual_local(owner) then
				return
			end
		else
			time_mod = 0.3
		end

		action.is_darkened = true

		target_darken = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_darken, 0.5)
		duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.15)

		field:Darken('support_skill_declare', target_darken, duration * time_mod)
	end

	support_action_util.unset_darken = function(action, duration)
		if not action then
			return
		end

		--- 암전을 한 적이 없다면 생략함
		if not action.is_darkened then
			return
		end

		action.is_darkened = nil

		--- 필드가 없다면 생략함
		if not field then
			return
		end

		duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.15)

		field:Undarken('support_skill_declare', duration)
	end

	--로그체스 어빌리티 옵션 파싱
	rogue_chess_util.parse_ability_buff_info = function(params)
		local buff_info_table = {}
		local buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffName')

		if buff_name == nil then
			local idx = 1
			buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffName_' .. idx)

			while buff_name ~= nil do
				table.insert(buff_info_table, {
					name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffName_' .. idx),
				})

				idx = idx + 1
				buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffName_' .. idx)
			end
		else
			table.insert(buff_info_table, {
				name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffName'),
			})
		end

		return buff_info_table
	end

	rogue_chess_util.handle_summoner_spell_range = function(zone, pos, range_green, range_red)
		local pos_contained = false
		local range
		if zone.Bounds:Contains(pos) then
			pos_contained = true
			range = range_green
			range_red:Hide()
		else
			range = range_red
			range_green:Hide()
		end

		if not range.gameObject.activeSelf then
			range:Show()
		end
		range:SetupByPosition(pos, pos.y)
		return pos_contained
	end

	rogue_chess_util.count_elemental_type_in_rosters = function(target_class)
		-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
		local rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
		if rc_sub_system.Deck == nil then
			return 0
		end

		-- 로스터 캐릭터 속성 카운트
		local rosters = rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
		local elemental_count_table = {}
		local highest_value = 0
		local highest_type = nil

		for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
			local character = rosters[i].Character
			if target_class ~= nil and character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass ~= target_class then
				break
			end

			local elemental_type = character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType
			local new_value
			if elemental_count_table[elemental_type] == nil then
				new_value = 1
			else
				new_value = elemental_count_table[elemental_type] + 1
			end

			elemental_count_table[elemental_type] = new_value

			if highest_value < elemental_count_table[elemental_type] then
				highest_value = new_value
				highest_type = elemental_type
			end
		until true end

		return highest_type, highest_value
	end

	rogue_chess_util.is_all_same_elemental_type = function(target_class)
		-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
		local rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
		if rc_sub_system.Deck == nil then
			return false
		end

		-- 로스터 캐릭터 속성 카운트
		local elemental_type = nil
		local rosters = rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
		for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do
			local character = rosters[i].Character
			if target_class ~= nil and character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass ~= target_class then
				break
			end

			if elemental_type then
				if elemental_type ~= character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType then
					return false
				end
			else
				elemental_type = character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	function battle_state_base:new(mt)
		local obj = {}
		setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
		return obj
	end

	--- battle_state를 구동하기 위한 머신
	---@class battle_state_machine
	battle_state_machine = {
		--- 현재 작동중인 state
		---@type battle_state_base
		state = nil,
		--- combo_state 처리를 도와주기 위한 helper
		---@type combo_state_helper
		combo_helper = nil,
	}
	battle_state_machine.mt = { __index = battle_state_machine }

	function battle_state_machine:new(combo_helper)
		local obj = {}
		setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
		obj.combo_helper = combo_helper
		return obj
	end

	--- 상태가 있는지 체크
	function battle_state_machine:is_nil_state()
		return self.state == nil
	end

	--- 다음 상태로 전이
	function battle_state_machine:change(new_state)
		local prev_state = self.state

		if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
			prev_state:exit(new_state)
		end

		self.state = new_state

		if self.state then
			if self.state.current_time_passed then
				self.state.current_time_passed = 0
			end

			if self.combo_helper ~= nil then
				self.combo_helper:reset_time_passed(self.state)
			end

			if self.state.enter then
				self.state:enter(prev_state)
			end
		end
	end

	function battle_state_machine:update(dt)
		if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
			return
		end

		local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
		self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

		if self.state.update then
			self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
		end

		if self:is_nil_state() or self.combo_helper == nil then
			return
		end

		if not self.combo_helper:check_update_time(self.state, old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt) then
			return
		end

		self.combo_helper:state_end_routine(self)
	end

	--- 콤보 액션 state_machine의 처리를 도와줄 핼퍼
	---@class combo_state_helper
	combo_state_helper = {
		--- 이 객체의 ifo 소유주
		owner = nil,
		--- 이 객체의 cs_action 소유주
		cs_action = nil,
	}
	combo_state_helper.mt = { __index = combo_state_helper }

	function combo_state_helper:new(cs_action, owner)
		local obj = {}
		setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
		obj.owner = owner
		obj.cs_action = cs_action
		return obj
	end

	function combo_state_helper:reset_time_passed(state)
		if state.finished_time_passed then
			state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end
	end

	function combo_state_helper:check_update_time(state, old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
		-- combo action용 state만 지원함
		if state.finished_time_passed == nil then return false end

		-- 아직 state가 종료되기 전인 경우 생략
		if state.action_duration > time_passed then return false end

		-- state가 종료된 뒤에는 지난 시간을 측정한다.
		if state.action_duration <= old_time_passed then
			state.finished_time_passed = state.finished_time_passed + dt
		end

		return true
	end

	function combo_state_helper:state_end_routine(battle_machine)
		local is_there_next = self.cs_action.IsThereNext
		local combo_window = self.cs_action.ComboWindow

		-- 콤보 액션의 경우에 한하여 처리를 진행한다.
		if is_there_next == nil or combo_window == nil then
			return
		end

		if is_there_next and combo_window > 0 then
			if battle_machine.state.finished_time_passed > combo_window then
				--- 스테이트 리셋
				battle_machine:change(nil)
			elseif battle_machine.state.finished_time_passed == 0 then
				--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
				message_system_util.publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
			end
		else
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			battle_machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system_util.publish_sync(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		end
	end
end

---aabb to aabb 충돌 계산
--- @param src Bounds
--- @param dest Bounds
--- @return boolean
function bounds_util.is_overlapping(src, dest)
	return src.max.x >= dest.min.x and src.min.x <= dest.max.x and
			src.max.y >= dest.min.y and src.min.y <= dest.max.y and
			src.max.z >= dest.min.z and src.min.z <= dest.max.z
end

---aabb to aabb x,z 좌표 기준으로 계산
--- @param src Bounds
--- @param dest Bounds
--- @return boolean
function bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(src, dest)
	return src.max.x >= dest.min.x and src.min.x <= dest.max.x and
			src.max.z >= dest.min.z and src.min.z <= dest.max.z
end

return {
	create = function()
		return bounds_util
	end
}

---@class CameraUtilMoveData 카메라 이동 관련 데이터 테이블
---@field ignorecameragrids boolean|nil 카메라 그리드 무시하는지 여부
---@field use_unscaledtime boolean|nil 타임스케일에 영향받지 않는 시간을 사용할지
---@field end_target ICharacter|nil 이동이 끝나고 카메라가 따라다닐 타겟
---@field target IFieldObject|nil 카메라 이동시킬 목표 오브젝트

--- 카메라 이동
---@param position Vector3 카메라 이동시킬 위치
---@param duration number 카메라 이동에 걸릴 시간
---@param data CameraUtilMoveData
function camera_util.move(position, duration, data)
	local pos
	if type_util.is_array(position) then
		pos = vector(position[1], position[2], position[3])
	else
		pos = position
	end

	local ignore_camera_grid = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'ignorecameragrids', false)
	local end_target = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_target', nil)
	local target = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'target', nil)
	local use_unscaled_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'use_unscaledtime', false)

	stage_camera:Move(target, pos or unity_class.vector3.zero, duration or 0, end_target, ignore_camera_grid, use_unscaled_time)
end

---@class CameraUtilMoveAsyncData 카메라 Async 이동 관련 데이터 테이블
---@field end_target ICharacter 이동이 끝나고 카메라가 따라다닐 타겟
---@field ignorecameragrids boolean 카메라 그리드 무시하는지 여부

---@param duration number 카메라 이동에 걸릴 시간

function camera_util.move_async(position, duration, data)
	local pos
	if type_util.is_array(position) then

	else

	end

	local end_target = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_target', nil)
	local ignore_camera_grid = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'ignorecameragrids', false)

	yield_return(stage_camera, "MoveAsync", pos, duration, end_target, ignore_camera_grid)
end

---@param duration number 카메라 이동에 걸릴 시간
---@param data CameraUtilMoveData
function camera_util.move_to_target(target, duration, data)
	if not (lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.Character) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.FieldObject)) then
		return
	end

	local pos = target.Position

	camera_util.move(pos, duration, data)

--- 카메라 필드 오브젝트의 위치로 이동 - 끝까지 기다림
---@param target IFieldObject 카메라 이동시킬 목표 오브젝트
---@param duration number 카메라 이동에 걸릴 시간
---@param data CameraUtilMoveAsyncData
function camera_util.move_to_target_async(target, duration, data)
	if not (lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.Character) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.FieldObject)) then

	end

	local pos = target.Position

--- 카메라 필드 오브젝트를 입력 시간 동안 추적하여 이동
---@param target IFieldObject 카메라 이동시킬 목표 오브젝트
---@param duration number 카메라 이동에 걸릴 시간

function camera_util.follow_target(target, duration, data)
	if not (lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.Character) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.FieldObject)) then
		return
	end

	--data를 넣지 않는다면 기본적으로 이동 완료후 target을 따라감.
	local end_target = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'end_target', target)
	local ignore_camera_grid = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'ignorecameragrids', false)

	stage_camera:Move(target, duration, end_target, ignore_camera_grid)
end

--- 카메라 크기 조절
---@param target_size number 변경할 카메라 크기
---@param duration number 변경 시간
---@param use_unscaled_time boolean 타임스케일에 영향받지 않는 시간을 사용할지 여부 (default: false)
function camera_util.resize_to(target_size, duration, use_unscaled_time)
	local unscaled_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(use_unscaled_time, false)
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(target_size, duration, unscaled_time)
end

--- 카메라 기본 사이즈로 조절
---@param duration number 변경 시간
---@param use_unscaled_time boolean 타임스케일에 영향받지 않는 시간을 사용할지 여부 (default: false)
function camera_util.resize_to_default(duration, use_unscaled_time)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.5)
	local unscaled_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(use_unscaled_time, false)

	stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(duration, unscaled_time)
end

--- 카메라 기본 사이즈로 조절 - 끝까지 기다림
---@param duration number 기본 카메라 사이즈로 돌아가는 시간
---@param use_unscaled_time boolean 타임스케일에 영향받지 않는 시간을 사용할지 여부 (default: false)
function camera_util.resize_to_default_async(duration, use_unscaled_time)
	local unscaled_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(use_unscaled_time, false)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(duration, use_unscaled_time)

	if unscaled_time then
		wait_for_unscaled_sec(duration)
	else
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end
end

--- 화면비 비례하여 카메라 크기 조절.
--- 카메라 기본 사이즈가 해상도에 따라 다름.
--- 4를 기준으로 잡아 (타겟 사이즈)x(기본 사이즈 / 4)을 카메라 사이즈로 사용
---@param target_size number 변경할 카메라 크기
---@param duration number 변경 시간
---@param use_unscaled_time boolean 타임스케일에 영향받지 않는 시간을 사용할지 여부 (default: false)
function camera_util.resize_by_ratio(target_size, duration, use_unscaled_time)
	camera_util.resize_to(target_size * stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() / 4,
			duration, use_unscaled_time)
end

--- 화면비 비례하여 카메라 크기 조절 - 끝까지 기다림
---@param target_size number 변경할 카메라 크기
---@param duration number 변경 시간
---@param use_unscaled_time boolean 타임스케일에 영향받지 않는 시간을 사용할지 여부 (default: false)
function camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(target_size, duration, use_unscaled_time)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(target_size, duration, use_unscaled_time)
	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

--- 파티 리더로 카메라 복귀
---@param duration number 복귀 시간
function camera_util.return_to_leader(duration)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 1)
	local current_leader = get_party_leader()
	camera_util.move_async(current_leader.Position, duration, { end_target = current_leader })
end

return {
	create = function()
		return camera_util
	end

--- 캐릭터의 direction을 가져옴
---@param dir string|Direction

function character_util.get_direction(dir)
	if type_util.is_string(dir) then
		return direction_constants[dir]
	end

end

---캐릭터 방향 전환
--- @param fo 'string'|ICharacter 방향 바꾸는 캐릭터
--- @param dir string|Direction 바라볼 방향
function character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end

	if type_util.is_string(fo) then
		fo = get_character(fo)

		if fo == nil then
			return
		end
	end

	local dir_to_change = character_util.get_direction(dir)

	if dir_to_change == nil then
		local log_message = "Invalid direction to change. Entered direction(in string) : " .. dir
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(log_message)
		return
	end

	fo.Direction = dir_to_change
end

	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

	-- Animation에 관한 값이 Table로 들어왔을 경우 그냥 사용하고 아닐 경우 값이 name이라 가정하고 테이블로 만듬

	if not type_util.is_table(emo) then

	else

---@class SetAnimInfo 설정할 애니메이션 정보
---@field name string 애니메이션 이름
---@field priority nil|any 애니메이션의 우선순위. type:CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities
---@field loop nil|boolean 루프 여부
---@field upper nil|boolean 상체 애니메이션 여부
---@field scale nil|number 재생할 애니메이션의 timescale
---@field remove_after nil|number 0보다 클 경우 해당 시간이 지나면 애니메이션 제거
---@field mix_duration nil|number 애니메이션 믹싱을 할 시간
---@field sfx_name nil|string|function
---@field sfx_key nil|string
---@field next_anim nil|string 애니메이션이 재생되고 이어서 실행될 애니메이션
---@field sfx_callback nil|function

---캐릭터 애니메이션 변경
---@param fo ICharacter 설정할 캐릭터
---@param args SetAnimInfo 설정할 애니메이션 정보
function character_util.set_anim(fo, args)
	if fo == nil or args == nil or args.name == nil then
		return
	end

	local anim_name = args.name
	local priority = lua_helper.get_value(args, "priority", CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom)
	local loop = lua_helper.get_value(args, "loop", true)
	local upper = lua_helper.get_value(args, "upper", false)
	local scale = lua_helper.get_value(args, "scale", 1)
	local remove_after = lua_helper.get_value(args, "remove_after", -1)
	local mix_duration = lua_helper.get_value(args, "mix_duration", nil)
	local sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(args, "sfx_name", nil)
	local sfx_key = lua_helper.get_value(args, "sfx_key", nil)
	local next_anim = lua_helper.get_value(args, "next_anim", nil)
	local sfx_callback = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'sfx_callback', nil)

	-- sfx 콜백 추가 루틴
	local sfx_handler

	if type_util.is_string(sfx_name) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(sfx_name) then
		sfx_handler = CS.Oak.LuaScriptOperationHelper.KeyframeSoundPlayDelegate(fo, sfx_key, sfx_name)
	elseif type_util.is_function(sfx_name) then
		sfx_handler = sfx_name
	end

	--sfx 함수용 콜백
	if type_util.is_function(sfx_callback) then
		if type_util.is_string(sfx_key) and not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(sfx_key) then
			local callback_func = function(_, sfx)
				if sfx_key == sfx.String then
					sfx_callback()
				end
			end

			sfx_handler = callback_func
		else
			sfx_handler = sfx_callback
		end
	end

	if upper == true then
		fo:SetUpperAnimation(
			CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(
				anim_name,
				priority,
				loop,
				scale,
				remove_after,
				mix_duration,
				sfx_handler,
				next_anim
			)
		)
	else
		fo:SetAnimation(
			CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(
				anim_name,
				priority,
				loop,
				scale,
				remove_after,
				mix_duration,
				sfx_handler,
				next_anim
			)
		)
	end
end

-- 캐릭터의 애니메이션에 sfx 콜백을 등록한다.
---@param fo ICharacter 설정할 캐릭터
---@param data string|{ name:string, key:string }
function character_util.add_animation_sfx(fo, data)
	if fo == nil or fo.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.AnimationState == nil then
		return
	end

	local name, key

	if type(data) == "string" then
		name = data
	else
		name = lua_helper.get_value(data, "name")
		key = lua_helper.get_value(data, "key")
	end

	local sfx_handler = CS.Oak.LuaScriptOperationHelper.KeyframeSoundPlayDelegate(fo, key, name)

	CS.Oak.CharacterAnimationSfxExtensions.TryAddSfxHandler(fo, sfx_handler)
end

-- 캐릭터의 애니메이션에 등록되어있는 sfx 콜백을 제거한다.

function character_util.remove_animation_sfx(fo)
	if fo == nil or fo.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.AnimationState == nil then
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.CharacterAnimationSfxExtensions.UnsubscribeAndRemoveSfxHandler(fo)
end

---@param wait boolean|nil
---@param last_direction string|Direction|nil
function character_util.jump_move(fo, target_pos, speed, height, wait, last_direction)
	local default_wait = lua_helper.get_or_default(wait, true)

	local dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(character_util.get_direction(last_direction), CS.Oak.Direction.None)

	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(target_pos, speed, false, dir)
	info.yMode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
	local duration = info:GetDuration(fo.Position)

	character_util.jump(fo, height, duration)
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(fo, info)

	if default_wait == true then
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end
end

---@private
---@deprecated 더 이상 사용하지 않음. wp_util.move 사용할 것
function character_util.move_waypoint(fo, waypointlist, speed, run, endtype, ymode,lastdirection, playsfx,
										animtimescale, callback)
	if fo == nil then return end

	local dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(character_util.get_direction(lastdirection), CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	local sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(playsfx, false)
	local anitime = lua_helper.get_or_default(animtimescale, 0)

	local wp, end_type, y_mode

	if waypointlist.Count == nil then
		wp = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if type_util.is_array(waypointlist) then
			for _, point in ipairs(waypointlist) do
				wp:Add(point)
			end
		else
			wp:Add(waypointlist)
		end
	else
		wp = waypointlist
	end

	end_type = endtype
	if type_util.is_string(endtype) then
		end_type = waypoint_move_end_type[endtype]
	end

	y_mode = ymode
	if type_util.is_string(ymode) then
		y_mode = character_y_mode_constants[ymode]
	end

	local move_info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()
	move_info.waypoints = wp
	move_info.speed = speed
	move_info.lastDirection = dir or CS.Oak.Direction.None
	move_info.endType = end_type or CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Stop
	move_info.yMode = y_mode or CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free
	move_info.run = run
	move_info.playSfx = sfx
	move_info.animTimeScale = anitime
	move_info.callback = callback

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(fo, move_info)
	return move_info
end

---@private
---@deprecated 더 이상 사용하지 않음. wp_util.move 사용할 것
function character_util.move_way_points(fo, data)
	if fo == nil then return end

	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()

	info.lastDirection = lua_helper.get_value(data, "last_direction", CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	local waypoints = lua_helper.get_value(data, "waypoints")
	local waypoint_list = nil
	if waypoints.Count == nil then
		waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if type_util.is_array(waypoints) then
			for _, point in ipairs(waypoints) do
				waypoint_list:Add(point)
			end
		else
			-- 포인트가 하나일때
			waypoint_list:Add(waypoints)
		end
	else
		-- C# List<T> 일때
		waypoint_list = waypoints
	end

	info.waypoints = waypoint_list
	info.speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, "speed")
	info.run = lua_helper.get_value(data, "run")
	info.playSfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, "play_sfx", false)

	local ymode = lua_helper.get_value(data, "ymode", nil)
	local y_mode = nil
	if type_util.is_string(ymode) then
		y_mode = character_y_mode_constants[ymode]
	end

	info.yMode = y_mode or CS.oak.CharacterYMode.Free
	info.animTimeScale = lua_helper.get_value(data, "anim_time_scale", 0)

	local end_type_val = lua_helper.get_value(data, "end_type")

	info.endType = end_type_val
	if type_util.is_string(end_type_val) then
		info.endType = waypoint_move_end_type[end_type_val]
	end

	info.callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, "callback")

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(fo, info)
end

---@deprecated 더 이상 사용하지 않음. wp_util.move_async 사용할 것
function character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, waypoints, speed, run, endtype, ymode, lastdirection, playsfx,
											  animtimescale)
	local waypoint_count = 0
	if waypoints.Count == nil then
		if type_util.is_array(waypoints) then
			for _, _ in ipairs(waypoints) do
				waypoint_count = waypoint_count + 1
			end
		else
			waypoint_count = 1
		end
	else
		waypoint_count = waypoints.Count
	end

	local move_end = false
	local cb = function(waypoint_index)
		move_end = waypoint_count == waypoint_index + 1
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(fo, waypoints, speed, run, endtype, ymode, lastdirection, playsfx, animtimescale, cb)

	while (not move_end and fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

---지정한 애니메이션을 N번 실행시켜주는 함수
---@param target ICharacter
---@param data SetAnimationNTimesAsyncInfo
function character_util.set_animation_n_times(target, data)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
		stage.StageGameObject,
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, target, data)
	)
end

---@class SetAnimationNTimesAsyncInfo
---@field name string|nil
---@field scale number|nil
---@field mix_duration number|nil
---@field count number|nil
---@field delay number|nil
---@field upper boolean|nil
---@field sfx string|function|nil
---@field keep_anim boolean|nil
---@field end_call_func function|nil

---지정한 애니메이션을 N번 실행시켜주는 함수 (async)
---@param target ICharacter
---@param data SetAnimationNTimesAsyncInfo
function character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(target, data)
	local name = lua_helper.get_value(data, "name")
	local scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, "scale", 1)
	local mix_duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'mix_duration', nil)
	local count = lua_helper.get_value(data, "count", 1)
	local delay = lua_helper.get_value(data, "delay", 0)
	local upper = lua_helper.get_value(data, "upper", false)
	local sfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, "sfx") -- 애니메이션 키 프레임 마다 호출될 sfx명 혹은 콜백 함수
	local keep_anim = lua_helper.get_value(data, "keep_anim", false)
	local end_call_func = lua_helper.get_value(data, "end_call_func", nil) -- 애니 지정한 횟수 끝난 후 실행될 함수

	if name == nil then
		return
	end

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(target, name) / scale

	character_util.set_anim(target, {name = name, loop = count > 1, scale = scale, mix_duration = mix_duration, sfx_name = sfx, upper = upper})

	for _ = 1, count do
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(anim_duration))
	end

	if end_call_func ~= nil then
		end_call_func()
		return true
	end

	if not keep_anim then
		character_util.remove_anim(target, upper)
	end

	if delay > 0 then
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(delay))
	end
end

function character_util.nod_twice(target)

--- 파티가 아닌 npc들을 파티원 정렬 해주는 함수 (AlignPartyNew를 컨버팅)
--- @param group ICharacter[] 정렬 시킬 npc들
--- @param pos Vector3 정렬 기준이 되는 위치
--- @param dir string|Direction 정렬 방향
--- @param duration number|nil 정렬 시간
--- @param type string|nil 정렬 방식
--- @param ignore_deactivated_npc boolean|nil 비활성화된 npc는 무시하는 옵션
function character_util.align_npc_group(group, pos, dir, duration, type, ignore_deactivated_npc)
	dir = type_util.is_string(dir) and character_util.get_direction(dir) or dir
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 1)
	type = lua_helper.get_or_default(type, "linear")
	ignore_deactivated_npc = lua_helper.get_or_default(ignore_deactivated_npc, false)

	local z_offset = 0
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		z_offset = -0.011
	end

	local align_pos = pos + direction_util.to_vector3(dir) + vector(0, 0, z_offset)

	local opposite_dir = direction_util.get_opposite(dir)

	local min_speed = 1
	local step_threshold = 0.5

	local ignore_npc_count = 0

	if type == "linear" then
		for i = 1, #group do
			local npc = group[i]

			if not ignore_deactivated_npc or npc.ActiveState ~= active_state_type.disabled then
				local final_pos = character_util.calculate_align_pos(#group, align_pos, dir, i, type)

				if ignore_deactivated_npc then
					final_pos =
						character_util.calculate_align_pos(
						#group,
						align_pos,
						dir,
						i - ignore_npc_count,
						type,
						ignore_npc_count
					)
				end

				if duration <= 0 then
					npc.Position = final_pos
					character_util.set_direction(npc, opposite_dir)
				else
					local cur_pos = npc.Position
					local diff = final_pos - npc.Position
					local dist = diff.magnitude
					local step_dist = math.abs(diff.x) + math.abs(diff.z)

					if not float_util.is_almost_zero(dist) then
						if math.abs(diff.x) < step_threshold or math.abs(diff.z) < step_threshold then
							local speed = dist / duration
							if speed < min_speed then
								speed = min_speed
							end

							character_util.move_waypoint(npc, final_pos, speed, false, "stop", "floor", opposite_dir)
						else
							local x_first = false
							local z_first = false

							if npc.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and diff.x < 0 then
								x_first = true
							elseif npc.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and diff.x > 0 then
								x_first = true
							elseif npc.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up and diff.z > 0 then
								z_first = true
							elseif npc.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down and diff.z < 0 then
								z_first = true
							end

							if not x_first and not z_first then
								if opposite_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or opposite_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
									x_first = true
								else
									z_first = true
								end
							end

							if x_first then
								local diff_x = diff
								-- diff.z = 0

								local speed = step_dist / duration
								if speed < min_speed then
									speed = min_speed
								end

								local waypoints = {
									cur_pos + diff_x,
									final_pos
								}

								character_util.move_waypoint(
									npc,
									waypoints,
									speed,
									false,
									"stop",
									"floor",
									opposite_dir
								)
							else
								local diff_z = diff
								-- diff.x = 0

								local speed = step_dist / duration
								if speed < min_speed then
									speed = min_speed
								end

								local waypoints = {
									cur_pos + diff_z,
									final_pos
								}

								character_util.move_waypoint(
									npc,
									waypoints,
									speed,
									false,
									"stop",
									"floor",
									opposite_dir
								)
							end
						end
					else
						character_util.set_direction(npc, opposite_dir)
						character_util.stop(npc)
					end
				end
			else
				ignore_npc_count = ignore_npc_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif type == "arc" then
		for i = 1, #group do
			local npc = group[i]

			if not ignore_deactivated_npc or npc.ActiveState ~= active_state_type.disabled then
				local target_pos = character_util.calculate_align_pos(#group, align_pos, dir, i, type)

				if ignore_deactivated_npc then
					target_pos =
						character_util.calculate_align_pos(
						#group,
						align_pos,
						dir,
						i - ignore_npc_count,
						type,
						ignore_npc_count
					)
				end

				local diff = target_pos - npc.Position
				local dist = diff.magnitude

				if duration <= 0 or float_util.is_almost_zero(dist) then
					npc.Position = target_pos
					character_util.set_direction(npc, opposite_dir)
				else
					local speed = dist / duration
					if speed < min_speed then
						speed = min_speed
					end

					character_util.move_waypoint(npc, target_pos, speed, false, "stop", "free", opposite_dir)
				end
			else
				ignore_npc_count = ignore_npc_count + 1
			end
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

--- CalculatePartyMemberAlignPosition을 컨버팅
function character_util.calculate_align_pos(npc_group_count, align_pos, align_dir, group_npc_index, align_type, ignore_npc_count)
	ignore_npc_count = lua_helper.get_or_default(ignore_npc_count, 0)

	local group_index = group_npc_index - 1
	local group_count = npc_group_count - ignore_npc_count

	if group_index < 0 or group_index >= group_count then
		return align_pos
	end

	local dist = constants.dist_between_party_members * direction_util.to_vector3(align_dir)

	if align_type == "linear" then
		return align_pos + group_index * dist
	elseif align_type == "arc" then
		if group_count == 2 then
			return align_pos + group_index * dist
		elseif group_count == 3 then
			if group_index == 1 then
				return align_pos + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-45, unity_class.vector3.up) * dist
			elseif group_index == 2 then
				return align_pos + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(45, unity_class.vector3.up) * dist
			end
		elseif group_count == 4 then
			if group_index == 1 then
				return align_pos + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-60, unity_class.vector3.up) * dist
			elseif group_index == 2 then
				return align_pos + dist
			elseif group_index == 3 then
				return align_pos + unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(60, unity_class.vector3.up) * dist
			end
		elseif group_count >= 5 and group_index >= 1 then
			local angles = {-60, 60, 0, -45, 45}
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angles[group_index - 1] % #angles, unity_class.vector3.up)
			local target_pos = align_pos + rot * (group_index / constants.max_party_member_count + 1) * dist
			return target_pos
		end
	end

	return align_pos
end

---@param type string|any 물리 기반인지 선형인지 (CS.Oak.KnockBackType)
---@param stun boolean|nil stun 된 상태의 넉백인지
---@param direction Vector3|number[] 넉백 당하는 방향
---@param impact_force number|nil 물리 기반 넉백 파라메터
---@param impact_time number|nil 물리 기반 넉백 파라메터
---@param mucoefficient number|nil 물리 기반 넉백 파라메터
---@param jump boolean|nil 넉백시 점프할 것인지
---@param wall_damage boolean|nil 벽 충돌 데미지를 허용할 것인지
---@param linear_duration number|nil 선형 넉백 파라메터
---@param linear_magnitude number|nil 선형 넉백 파라메터
---@return KnockBackInfo
function character_util.knockback_info(type, stun, direction, impact_force, impact_time, mucoefficient, jump,
										 wall_damage, linear_duration, linear_magnitude)
	local ktype, kdirection
	if type_util.is_string(type) then
		if type == "physics" then
			ktype = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Physics
		elseif type == "linear" then
			ktype = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Linear
		end
	else
		ktype = type
	end

	if type_util.is_array(direction) then
		kdirection = vector(direction[1], direction[2], direction[3])
	else
		kdirection = direction
	end

	local is_stun = lua_helper.get_or_default(stun, false)
	local is_jump = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump, false)
	local is_wall_damage = lua_helper.get_or_default(wall_damage, false)

	local info = CS.Oak.KnockBackInfo()
	info.type = ktype
	info.direction = kdirection
	info.impactForce = impact_force
	info.impactTime = impact_time
	info.muCoefficient = mucoefficient
	info.linearDuration = linear_duration
	info.linearMagnitude = linear_magnitude
	info.stun = is_stun
	info.jump = is_jump
	info.allowWallDamage = is_wall_damage

	return info
end

--- 넉백 info에 따른 연출용 넉백, 연출 루틴 아래서 실행한다. (상태 변경 없이 포지션만 세팅한다)
---@param target IFieldObject|any 넉백 적용 대상
---@param info KnockBackInfo|any 넉백 관련 정보 구조체
---@param limit_time number|nil 해당 시간 이후 강제 종료
---@param block_callback function|nil 충돌 후 정지 콜백
---@param finish_callback function|nil 만료 콜백
function character_util.get_knock_back_routine(target, info, limit_time, block_callback, finish_callback)
	--- 밀 대상이 없다면 의미가 없다. 스킵
	if is_unity_null(target) then return end

	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = target.Position
	local knock_back_duration
	--- 넉백 연출 종료 체크 함수, 다음 이동 포지션 계산 함수
	local is_done_func, calc_next_pos_func

	--- 물리에 의한 이동
	if info.type == CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Physics then
		--- 물리 계산기 할당
		local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(
			0, target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient,
			info.impactForce,
			info.impactTime
		)
		knock_back_duration = friction:GetTotalTime()
		--- 제한이 없다면 물리 계산기의 최대 시간으로
		limit_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(limit_time, knock_back_duration)

		is_done_func = function() return friction:IsDone() end
		calc_next_pos_func = function()
			friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			return start_pos + info.direction * friction:GetDistance()
		end

	--- 선형 이동
	elseif info.type == CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Linear then
		local knock_back_time_passed = 0
		local progress, evaled_pos

		knock_back_duration = info.linearDuration
		--- 제한이 없다면 선형연출 지속시간
		limit_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(limit_time, knock_back_duration)

		is_done_func = function() return knock_back_time_passed >= info.linearDuration end
		calc_next_pos_func = function()
			knock_back_time_passed = knock_back_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			progress = math.min(knock_back_time_passed / info.linearDuration, 1)
			return start_pos + info.direction * info.linearMagnitude * progress
		end
	end

	if target.SpineController ~= nil then
		if info.jump then
			character_util.jump(target, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceJump, knock_back_duration - 0.02)
		end

		--- 스턴 애니메이션 재생
		if info.stun then
			local anim_info = { name = target:GetCustomDamagedAnimation(), priority = CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, loop = false }
			character_util.set_anim(target, anim_info)
		end
	end

	local is_blocked = false

	--- 넉백 지속시간, 강제 종료시간 까지 실행
	while not (is_done_func() or unity_class.time.time - start_time > limit_time) do
		local move_vector = calc_next_pos_func() - target.Position
		local move_result

		--- 블록 될 때 까지 이동
		if not is_blocked then
			if string.find(target.name, '시즌') then
				local a = 1
			end
			move_result = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(target, move_vector)
		end

		--- 먼가에 의해 충돌했다.
		if move_result and move_result.stopper ~= nil then
			is_blocked = true

			--- 벽 충돌 콜백 실행
			if block_callback then block_callback(move_result.stopper) end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--- 만료 콜백 실행
	if finish_callback then finish_callback() end

	--- 만료되면 강제로 점프와 스턴을 풀어야하나?
end

---@return Emoticon
function character_util.show_emoticon(fo, base_scale, type, custom_sprite)
	-- 커스텀 스프라이트를 사용할 경우 load_util.emoticon_items_custom_shear_atlas() 사용하여 미리 로드 필요함
	if custom_sprite ~= nil and stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Get('spritesheets/items', 'emoticon_items_custom_shear') == nil then
		logger_util.error('\'emoticon_items_custom_shear\' atlas is not loaded')
	end

	local pos = lua_helper.type_compare(fo, unity_class.vector3) and fo or fo.Position
	local emoticon_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('emoticon'):Instantiate(pos)
	local emoticon = emoticon_pool.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.Emoticon))
	base_scale = base_scale == nil and unity_class.vector3.one or base_scale
	type = character_util.get_emoticon_type(type)

	emoticon:Init()
	emoticon:ShowOn(fo, base_scale, type, custom_sprite)

	return emoticon
end

---@class ShowEmoticonInfo
---@field attach_to_fo boolean|nil 캐릭터 transform에 붙일지
---@field scale number|nil 크기
---@field emoticon_time number|nil 출력 시간
---@field no_time_limit boolean|nil 계속 남아 있는지 여부
---@field offset Vector3|nil 오프셋

---이모티콘 (데이터 포함) 연출
---@param fo ICharacter
---@param base_scale Vector3|nil
---@param type string|EmoticonType
---@param custom_sprite string|nil
---@param data ShowEmoticonInfo
---@return Emoticon
function character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(fo, base_scale, type, custom_sprite, data)
	-- 커스텀 스프라이트를 사용할 경우 load_util.emoticon_items_custom_shear_atlas() 사용하여 미리 로드 필요함
	if custom_sprite ~= nil and stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Get('spritesheets/items', 'emoticon_items_custom_shear') == nil then
		logger_util.error('\'emoticon_items_custom_shear\' atlas is not loaded')
	end

	local pos = lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.UnityEngine.Transform) and fo.position or
			(lua_helper.type_compare(fo, unity_class.vector3) and fo or fo.Position)

	local attach_to_fo = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'attach_to_fo', false)
	local emoticon_pool
	if attach_to_fo == true then
		emoticon_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('emoticon'):Instantiate(pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, fo.Transform)
	else
		emoticon_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('emoticon'):Instantiate(pos)
	end

	local emoticon = emoticon_pool.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.Emoticon))
	base_scale = base_scale == nil and unity_class.vector3.one or base_scale
	type = character_util.get_emoticon_type(type)

	local scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'scale', 1.0)
	local emoticon_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'emoticon_time', nil)
	local no_time_limit = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'no_time_limit', false)
	local offset = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'offset', vector(0, 0, 1))
	local item_sprite_p2w = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'item_sprite_p2w', 0.02)

	emoticon:Init()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.UnityEngine.Transform) then
		emoticon:ShowOn(fo, base_scale, type, offset, custom_sprite, scale, emoticon_time, no_time_limit, item_sprite_p2w)
	else
		emoticon:ShowOn(fo, base_scale, type, custom_sprite, scale, emoticon_time, no_time_limit, item_sprite_p2w)
	end

	return emoticon
end

---캐릭터가 흔들리다가 일어나는 연출
---@param fo ICharacter
---@param dir string|Direction 방향
---@param num number|nil 쉐이크 횟수
---@param emotion_name string|nil 일어날 때 표정
---@param play_sound boolean|nil 일어날 때 사운드 출력 여부
function character_util.shake_and_wakeup(fo, dir, num, emotion_name, play_sound)
	local shake_num = lua_helper.get_or_default(num, 2)
	local play_sound_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_sound, false)

	for i = 1, shake_num do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.02, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	if play_sound_val then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	end

	if emotion_name ~= nil then
		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = emotion_name })
		character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	else
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
	end
	character_util.mario_jump_async(fo, dir)
end

---캐릭터 스피치와 애니메이션 이모션 동시 세팅
---@param fo ICharacter
---@param anim_data string|SetAnimInfo|nil
---@param emotion_data string|SetEmotionInfo|nil
---@param talk_data string|ShowSpeechBubbleInfo
function character_util.play_speech_action(fo, anim_data, emotion_data, talk_data)
	if anim_data ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_string(anim_data) then
			anim_data = { name = anim_data }
		end

		character_util.set_anim(fo, anim_data)
	end

	if emotion_data ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_string(emotion_data) then
			emotion_data = { name = emotion_data }
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(fo, emotion_data)
	end

	if type_util.is_string(talk_data) then
		talk_data = { key = talk_data, skip = true }
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo, talk_data)

	if anim_data ~= nil then
		local is_upper = lua_helper.get_value(anim_data, 'upper', nil)
		character_util.remove_anim(fo, is_upper)
	end

	if emotion_data ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
	end
end

--- 현재 캐릭터가 끼고 있는 무기의 스프라이트 이름을 리턴하는 함수
--- @param character ICharacter 타겟 캐릭터
--- @param is_first_weapon boolean Weapon1의 스프라이트를 가져올지 여부 false면 Weapon2
function character_util.get_weapon_sprite_name(character, is_first_weapon)
	local weapon_spec = is_first_weapon
			and character.CharacterInfo.Weapon1.WeaponSpec or character.CharacterInfo.Weapon2.WeaponSpec

	if character.CharacterInfo.EquipCostumes:ContainsKey(weapon_spec.WeaponTypeSpec.WeaponType) then
		local equip_costume = character.CharacterInfo.EquipCostumes[weapon_spec.WeaponTypeSpec.WeaponType]
		return equip_costume.EquipCostumeSpec.SpriteName
	end

	-- 코스튬 정보가 없다면 웨폰 스팩의 spriteName return
	return weapon_spec.SpriteName
end

	character:SetEquipment(weapon_slot, weapon, update)

	local instance_info = component_type:GetProperty("Instance", CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

	-- 싱글톤 인스턴스가 있으면 가져와서 사용
	if instance_info ~= nil then

		return CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(component_type)

--- Branch Datas Example = {
---    {'Choose 1', 'normal', reaction: LuaFunc, predicate: Boolean | LuaFunc  },
---    {'Choose 2', 'normal', reaction: LuaFunc, predicate: Boolean | LuaFunc  }
--- }
--- 위와 같은 데이터 인자가 넘겨지면 "Choose 1", "Choose 2" 라는 텍스트가 들어가있는 선택지 두개가 생김. 색깔은 기본값으로 하얀색 지원
--- 주어진 LuaFunc 콜백함수가 존재한다면 선택지가 선택될 때 콜백 함수도 불림.
---@param branch_datas any[][]
---@param reaction_func string|function 선택 이후 공통적으로 호출될 리액션 함수의 스트링 키 or 콜백 함수
---@return number 고른 선택지 번호
choose_util.play_choose_event = function(branch_datas, reaction_func)
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local wait = true
	local result = -1

	for i, data in ipairs(branch_datas) do
		local branch = {}
		local text

		local predicate_result = true
		local predicate = data[4]

		if predicate ~= nil then
			if type(predicate) == 'function' then
				predicate_result = predicate()
			elseif type(predicate) == 'boolean' then
				predicate_result = predicate
			end
		end

		if predicate_result then
			if type_util.is_array(data[1]) then
				text = game_string:FormatWithReservedKeywords(table.unpack(data[1]))
			else
				text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(data[1])
			end

			branch.Text = text
			branch.Tendency = choose_util.get_tendency(data[2])
			branch.Callback = function()
				wait = false
				result = i
			end

			branches:Add(branch)
		end
	end

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party_leader, branches)

	while wait do coroutine.yield(nil) end

	-- 체인된 콜백이 있으면 호출해줌.
	local chained_cb = branch_datas[result][3]
	if chained_cb ~= nil then
		chained_cb()
	end

	local reaction = choose_util.get_leader_reaction(reaction_func)
	if reaction ~= nil then
		reaction()
	end

	return result
end

---@class CustomTendency 색과 아이콘이 다른 커스텀 Tendency 데이터나, 조건에 따라 활성화 되는 Tendency 데이터가 필요할 떄 사용.
---@field name string|nil 'custom'(생략가능), 'normal', 'forced', 'intellect', 'brutal', 'mercy',
---@field color Color|nil CS.UnityEngine.Color32(r,g,b,a)
---@field icon string|nil MainUI Icon Sprite 이름
---@field active_state boolean|function|nil 활성화 조건. false면 선택지의 색이 회색으로 바뀌고 선택 불가능해짐.

--- Branch Datas Example = {
---    {'Choose 1', 'normal', reaction: LuaFunc, predicate: Boolean | LuaFunc  },
---    {'Choose 2', 'normal', reaction: LuaFunc, predicate: Boolean | LuaFunc  },
---    {'Choose 3', { tendency = 'custom', color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0,0,0,255), icon = 'icon_name',
---		active_state = param_a == param_b }, reaction: LuaFunc, predicate: Boolean | LuaFunc  },
---    {'Choose 4', { tendency = 'brutal', active_state = is_activate_func }, reaction: LuaFunc, predicate: Boolean | LuaFunc  },
--- }
--- 위와 같은 데이터 인자가 넘겨지면 "Choose 1", "Choose 2" 라는 텍스트가 들어가있는 선택지 두개가 생김. 색깔은 기본값으로 하얀색 지원
--- 주어진 LuaFunc 콜백함수가 존재한다면 선택지가 선택될 때 콜백 함수도 불림.
--- branch_datas의 tendency에 string 대신 CustomTendency 입력 가능
---@param branch_datas { branch_text:string, tendency:string|CustomTendency, reaction:function, predicate:boolean|function }
---@param reaction_func string|function 선택 이후 공통적으로 호출될 리액션 함수의 스트링 키 or 콜백 함수
---@param condition_cb function 조건에 따라 선택지를 바로 종료시키는 조건 체크 함수 (ex. 반환 값이 false일 경우 선택지 제거 후 종료)
choose_util.play_async = function(branch_datas, reaction_func, condition_cb)
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	if not condition_cb then
		condition_cb = function() return true end
	end

	local wait = true
	local result = -1
	for i, data in ipairs(branch_datas) do
		local branch = {}
		local text

		local predicate_result = true
		local predicate = data[4]

		if predicate ~= nil then
			if type(predicate) == 'function' then
				predicate_result = predicate()
			elseif type(predicate) == 'boolean' then
				predicate_result = predicate
			end
		end

		if predicate_result then
			if type_util.is_array(data[1]) then
				text = game_string:FormatWithReservedKeywords(table.unpack(data[1]))
			else
				text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(data[1])
			end

			branch.Text = text

			local tendency = data[2]

			if type_util.is_table(data[2]) then
				if type_util.is_function(tendency.active_condition) then
					tendency.active_condition = tendency.active_condition()
				end

				if tendency.name ~= nil and tendency.name ~= 'custom' then
					if tendency.active_condition == false then
						branch.Tendency = choose_util.get_tendency('custom')
						branch.TendencyIconSpirteName = choose_util.get_tendency_icon_name(tendency.name)
					else
						branch.Tendency = choose_util.get_tendency(tendency.name)
					end
				else
					branch.Tendency = choose_util.get_tendency('custom')
					branch.TendencyIconSpirteName = tendency.icon
					branch.TendencyColor = tendency.color
				end

				if tendency.active_condition == false then
					branch.TendencyColor = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(217, 217, 217, 255)
					branch.CanChoose = false
				end
			else
				branch.Tendency = choose_util.get_tendency(tendency)
			end

			branch.Callback = function()
				wait = false
				result = i
			end

			branches:Add(branch)
		end
	end

	-- acs는 AnswerChoiceState의 약자
	local acs = ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party_leader, branches)

	while wait and condition_cb() do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not condition_cb() then
		if acs ~= nil then
			acs.CancelCallback = function() end
			CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance:OnClickCirtain()
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 체인된 콜백이 있으면 호출해줌.
	if result ~= -1 then
		local chained_cb = branch_datas[result][3]
		if chained_cb ~= nil then
			chained_cb()
		end

		local reaction = choose_util.get_leader_reaction(reaction_func)
		if reaction ~= nil then
			reaction()
		end
	end
	return result
end

---@class SamplingDataElement
---@field tendency string 선택지 성향
---@field key string 선택지 대사
---@field choose_end boolean 탈출 선택지 여부
---@field keep boolean 선택지 유지 여부
---@field cb_func function 콜백 함수

--- 선택지를 비복원 추출 방식으로 연출 합니다.
--- @param sampling_data SamplingDataElement[]
choose_util.play_choose_sampling_without_replacement = function(sampling_data)
	local is_playing = true
	local result = -1
	local branch_data = {}
	local play_data = {}

	for i, data in ipairs(sampling_data) do
		branch_data[i] = { data.key, data.tendency, data.cb_func, data.predicate }
		play_data[i] = {
			choose_end = data.choose_end,
			keep = data.keep,
		}
	end

	while is_playing do
		result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branch_data)

		--탈출 선택지를 클릭했는지 확인
		if play_data[result].choose_end then
			--특정 선택지로 나갔을 경우 false
			return false
		end

		--선택지 제거 여부 확인
		if not play_data[result].keep then
			table.remove(branch_data, result)
			table.remove(play_data, result)
		end

		--모든 선택지가 제거되었을 경우 종료
		if #branch_data == 0 then
			is_playing = false
		end
	end

	--선택지를 모두 클릭 했을 경우 true
	return true
end

return {
	create = function()
		return choose_util
	end
}

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Yet Another Class Implementation (version 1.2)
--
-- Julien Patte [julien.patte AT gmail DOT com] - 25 Feb 2007
--
-- Inspired from code written by Kevin Baca, Sam Lie, Christian Lindig and others
-- Thanks to Damian Stewart and Frederic Thomas for their interest and comments

-- from http://lua-users.org/wiki/YetAnotherClassImplementation
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

do	-- keep local things inside

	-- associations between an object an its meta-informations
	-- e.g its class, its "lower" object (if any), ...
	local metaObj = {}
	setmetatable(metaObj, {__mode = "k"})

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'duplicate'
	-- return a shallow copy of table t

	local function duplicate(t)
		t2 = {}
		for k,v in pairs(t) do t2[k] = v end
		return t2
	end

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'newInstance'

	local function newInstance(class, ...)

		local function makeInstance(class, virtuals)
			local inst = duplicate(virtuals)
			metaObj[inst] = { obj = inst, class = class }

			if class:super()~=nil then
				inst.super = makeInstance(class:super(), virtuals)
				metaObj[inst].super = metaObj[inst.super]	-- meta-info about inst
				metaObj[inst.super].lower = metaObj[inst]
			else
				inst.super = {}
			end

			setmetatable(inst, class.static)

			return inst
		end

		local inst = makeInstance(class, metaObj[class].virtuals)
		inst:init(...)
		return inst
	end

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'makeVirtual'

	local function makeVirtual(class, fname)
		local func = class.static[fname]
		if func == nil then
			func = function() error("Attempt to call an undefined abstract method '"..fname.."'") end
		end
		metaObj[class].virtuals[fname] = func
	end

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'trycast'
	-- try to cast an instance into an instance of one of its super- or subclasses

	local function tryCast(class, inst)
		local meta = metaObj[inst]
		if meta.class==class then return inst end -- is it already the right class?

		while meta~=nil do	-- search lower in the hierarchy
			if meta.class==class then return meta.obj end
			meta = meta.lower
		end

		meta = metaObj[inst].super  -- not found, search through the superclasses
		while meta~=nil do
			if meta.class==class then return meta.obj end
			meta = meta.super
		end

		return nil -- could not execute casting
	end

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'secureCast'
	-- same as trycast but raise an error in case of failure

	local function secureCast(class, inst)
		local casted = tryCast(class, inst)
		if casted == nil then
			error("Failed to cast " .. tostring(inst) .. " to a " .. class:name())
		end
		return casted
	end

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'classMade'

	local function classMade(class, obj)
		if metaObj[obj]==nil then return false end -- is this really an object?
		return (tryCast(class,obj) ~= nil) -- check if that class could cast the object
	end


	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'callup'
	-- Function used to transfer a method call from a class to its superclass

	local callup_inst
	local callup_target

	local function callup(inst, ...)
		return callup_target(callup_inst, ...)	-- call the superclass' method
	end


	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- internal function 'subclass'

	local function inst_init_def(inst,...)
		inst.super:init()
	end

	local function inst_newindex(inst,key,value)
		if inst.super[key] ~= nil then 	-- First check if this field isn't already
			-- defined higher in the hierarchy
			inst.super[key] = value;		-- Update the old value
		else
			rawset(inst,key,value); 		-- Create the field
		end
	end

	local function subclass(baseClass, name)
		if type(name)~="string" then name = "Unnamed" end

		local theClass = {}

		-- need to copy everything here because events can't be found through metatables
		local b = baseClass.static
		local inst_stuff = { __tostring=b.__tostring, __eq=b.__eq, __add=b.__add, __sub=b.__sub,
		                     __mul=b.__mul, __div=b.__div, __mod=b.__mod, __pow=b.__pow, __unm=b.__unm,
		                     __len=b.__len, __lt=b.__lt, __le=b.__le, __concat=b.__concat, __call=b.__call}

		inst_stuff.init = inst_init_def
		inst_stuff.__newindex = inst_newindex
		function inst_stuff.class() return theClass end

		function inst_stuff.__index(inst, key) -- Look for field 'key' in instance 'inst'
			local res = inst_stuff[key] 		-- Is it present?
			if res~=nil then return res end		-- Okay, return it

			res = inst.super[key]  				-- Is it somewhere higher in the hierarchy?

			if type(res)=='function' and
					res ~= callup then 				-- If it is a method of the superclass,
				callup_inst = inst.super  		-- we will need to do a special forwarding
				callup_target = res  			-- to call 'res' with the correct 'self'
				return callup 					-- The 'callup' function will do that
			end

			return res
		end


		local class_stuff = { static = inst_stuff, made = classMade, new = newInstance,
		                      subclass = subclass, virtual = makeVirtual, cast = secureCast, trycast = tryCast }
		metaObj[theClass] = { virtuals = duplicate(metaObj[baseClass].virtuals) }

		function class_stuff.name(class) return name end
		function class_stuff.super(class) return baseClass end
		function class_stuff.inherits(class, other)
			return (baseClass==other or baseClass:inherits(other))
		end

		local function newmethod(class, name, meth)
			inst_stuff[name] = meth;
			if metaObj[class].virtuals[name]~=nil then
				metaObj[class].virtuals[name] = meth
			end
		end

		local function tos() return ("class "..name) end
		setmetatable(theClass, { __newindex = newmethod, __index = class_stuff,
		                         __tostring = tos, __call = newInstance } )

		-- [[ KONG STUDIOS EXPANSIONS ]] --
		function theClass:name()
			return tostring(self)
		end
		return theClass
	end

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- The 'Object' class

	Object = {}

	local function obj_newitem() error "May not modify the class 'Object'. Subclass it instead." end
	local obj_inst_stuff = {}
	function obj_inst_stuff.init(inst,...) end
	obj_inst_stuff.__index = obj_inst_stuff
	obj_inst_stuff.__newindex = obj_newitem
	function obj_inst_stuff.class() return Object end
	function obj_inst_stuff.__tostring(inst) return ("a "..inst:class():name()) end

	local obj_class_stuff = { static = obj_inst_stuff, made = classMade, new = newInstance,
	                          subclass = subclass, cast = secureCast, trycast = tryCast }
	function obj_class_stuff.name(class) return "Object" end
	function obj_class_stuff.super(class) return nil end
	function obj_class_stuff.inherits(class, other) return false end
	metaObj[Object] = { virtuals={} }

	local function tos() return ("class Object") end
	setmetatable(Object, { __newindex = obj_newitem, __index = obj_class_stuff,
	                       __tostring = tos, __call = newInstance } )

	----------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- function 'newclass'

	function newclass(name, baseClass)
		baseClass = baseClass or Object
		return baseClass:subclass(name)
	end
end -- 2 global things remain: 'Object' and 'newclass'

coroutine_util = {}

---@param coroutines Coroutine|Coroutine[] 대기할 코루틴들
function coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(coroutines)
    if coroutines == nil then return end

    local is_array = type_util.is_array(coroutines)
    while true do

        local all_routines_over = true
        if is_array then
            for _, coroutine in ipairs(coroutines) do
                if not coroutine.IsDone then
                    all_routines_over = false
                end
            end
        else
            for _, coroutine in pairs(coroutines) do
                if not coroutine.IsDone then
                    all_routines_over = false
                end
            end
        end

        if all_routines_over then
            break
        end

        coroutine.yield()
    end
end

--- 정해진 시간동안 매 프레임마다 지정한 함수를 실행 시켜주는 함수
--- 현재 시간의 진행도(progress)를 지정한 함수에 넘겨줌
---@param duration number 실행 시킬 시간
---@param frame_action function 프레임마다 실행될 함수
function coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, frame_action)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local keep_action = frame_action(progress)

		if keep_action == false then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	frame_action(1)
end

--- 정해진 시간동안 매 프레임마다 지정한 함수를 실행 시켜주는 함수
--- 시작 값과 끝 값을 기반으로 현재 진행도(progress)의 값을 지정한 함수에 넘겨줌
---@param duration number 실행 시킬 시간
---@param from number|Vector3|number[]|Vector3[] 시작 값
---@param to number|Vector3|number[]|Vector3[] 끝 값
---@param frame_action function 프레임마다 실행될 함수
function coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, from, to, frame_action)
	local is_table = type_util.is_table(from)
	local is_vector

	if is_table then
		is_vector = {}

		for key, value in pairs(from) do
			is_vector[key] = lua_helper.type_compare(value, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3)
		end

	else
		is_vector = lua_helper.type_compare(from, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		local cur_value

		if is_table then
			cur_value = {}

			for key, value in pairs(is_vector) do
				if value then
					cur_value[key] = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from[key], to[key], progress)
				else
					cur_value[key] = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(from[key], to[key], progress)
				end
			end

		else
			if is_vector then
				cur_value = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from, to, progress)
			else
				cur_value = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(from, to, progress)
			end
		end

		local keep_action = frame_action(progress, cur_value)

		if keep_action == false then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	frame_action(1, to)
end

return {
    create = function()
        return coroutine_util
    end
}

--- @param target IFieldObject 해당 IFieldObject가 부쉬에 숨어 있을 시 데미지 표시를 생략

function damage_util.show_damage_number(target, amount, color, pos, damage_scale, is_critical)

-- character_util의 move_to로는 움직일 수 없어 item_util용 move_to 작성
--- @param item any (DropItem) 움직일 아이템 (필수)
--- @param target_pos any (vector3) 움직일 위치 (필수)
--- @param duration number 움직이는데 걸리는 시간 speed와 둘 중 하나는 필수
--- @param speed number 움직이는 스피드 duration과 둘 중 하나는 필수
--- shadow_active 움직이는 동안 그림자를 끌 것인지
function drop_item_util.move_to_async(item, end_pos, duration, speed, data)
	local shadow_active = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'shadow_active', true)
	local start_pos = item.Position
	local move_end_shadow_active = item.ShadowTransform.gameObject.activeSelf

	if duration == nil and speed ~= nil then
		local diff = end_pos - start_pos
		duration = diff.magnitude / speed
	end

	if not shadow_active then
		item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress

		item.Position = cur_pos

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.Position = end_pos

	if move_end_shadow_active then
		item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
end

--- 높이를 고려해 아이템을 던지는 유틸 함수
--- @param item any (DropItem) 던질 아이템 (필수)
--- @param target_pos any (vector3) 던질 위치 (필수)
--- @param data table 세부 설정
--- 	ground_offset 			number 	바닥으로부터 떨어져 있을 높이
--- 	drop_start_offset 		number 	처음에 아이템이 바닥으로부터 떨어져 있는 높이
---		initial_velocity		number	아이템의 시작 속도
--- 	initial_acceleration	number	아이템의 시작 가속도
---		rotation_num			number	아이템이 360도 회전하는 횟수
function drop_item_util.throw_item(item, target_pos, data)
	local ground_offset = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'ground_offset', 0.125)
	local drop_start_offset =  lua_helper.get_value(data, 'drop_start_offset', 0.5)
	local initial_velocity = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'initial_velocity', 11)
	local initial_acceleration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'initial_acceleration', 28)
	local rotation_num = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'rotation_num', 3)

	local start_pos = item.Position
	local drop_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()

	drop_calculator:SetParameters(initial_velocity, initial_acceleration,
			field:GetTileInfoAt(start_pos):GetHeightAt(start_pos) + drop_start_offset, 0)
	drop_calculator:ScaleTime(1.2)

	while not drop_calculator:IsDone() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local drop_progress = drop_calculator:GetProgress()
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, drop_progress)

		local cur_pos = (start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress)

		local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(cur_pos):GetHeightAt(cur_pos) + ground_offset
		drop_calculator:Proceed(dt, floor_height)

		item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, unity_class.mathf.Max(drop_calculator:GetDistance(), floor_height), 0)

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, drop_progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 아이템을 이동시키는 연출용 유틸 함수

function drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(item, target_alpha, duration)
	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local item_start_color = item_sprite.TintColor
	local shadow_start_color = shadow_sprite.TintColor

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		item_sprite.TintColor = item_start_color * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_start_color.a, target_alpha, progress)
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_start_color * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_start_color.a, target_alpha, progress)
		item_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	item_sprite.TintColor = item_start_color * target_alpha
	shadow_sprite.TintColor = shadow_start_color * target_alpha
	item_sprite:Rebuild()
	shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

	end

	item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * end_scale
	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * end_scale

	create = function()

---@param custom_sprite string
local function is_item_spritesheet_loaded(custom_sprite)
    local atlas_manager = stage.StageCustomAtlasManager

    if custom_sprite ~= nil and atlas_manager:Get('spritesheets/items', 'emoticon_items_custom_shear') == nil then
        logger_util.error('\'emoticon_items_custom_shear\' atlas is not loaded')
    end
end

---@param type_str EmoticonType
local function get_emoticon_type(type_str)
	if type_util.is_string(type_str) then
		return emoticon_type[type_str]
	end

	-- 인풋값이 스트링이 아닐 경우 그냥 반환
	return type_str
end

---@param param EmoticonGenerateParam
---@return EmoticonAccessToken
local function show_emoticon_by_param(target, param)
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'type', nil)
	local custom_sprite = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'custom_sprite', nil)
	local base_scale = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'base_scale', vector(1, 1, 1))
	local scale = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'scale', 1.0)
	local active_duration = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'active_duration', 0.5)
	local wait_duration = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'wait_duration', 2)
	local remove_duration = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'remove_duration', 0.2)
	local no_time_limit = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'no_time_limit', false)
	local offset = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'offset', vector(0, 0, 1))
	local item_sprite_p2w = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'item_sprite_p2w', 0.02)
    local should_following = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'should_following', false)

	local emoticon_param = CS.Oak.EmoticonGenerateParam(target)

	type = character_util.get_emoticon_type(type)

	emoticon_param.EmoticonType = type
	emoticon_param.SpriteName = custom_sprite
	emoticon_param.BaseScale = base_scale
	emoticon_param.Scale = scale
	emoticon_param.ActiveDuration = active_duration
	emoticon_param.WaitDuration = wait_duration
	emoticon_param.ContentHideDuration = remove_duration
	emoticon_param.NoTimeLimit = no_time_limit
	emoticon_param.Offset = offset
	emoticon_param.ItemSpriteP2W = item_sprite_p2w
    emoticon_param.ShouldFollowing = should_following

	return stage.EmoticonManager:ShowOn(emoticon_param)
end

---@param target_transform Transform
---@param emoticon_type EmoticonType
---@param custom_sprite string
---@return EmoticonAccessToken
local function show_emoticon_by_transform(target_transform, emoticon_type, custom_sprite)
    is_item_spritesheet_loaded(custom_sprite)

    emoticon_type = get_emoticon_type(emoticon_type)

    return stage.EmoticonManager:ShowOn(target_transform, emoticon_type, custom_sprite)
end

---@param ifo IFieldObject
---@param emoticon_type EmoticonType
---@param custom_sprite string
---@return EmoticonAccessToken
local function show_emoticon_by_ifo(ifo, emoticon_type, custom_sprite)
    is_item_spritesheet_loaded(custom_sprite)

    emoticon_type = get_emoticon_type(emoticon_type)

    return stage.EmoticonManager:ShowOn(ifo, emoticon_type, custom_sprite)
end


---@param ... table | Transform | EmoticonType | string
function emoticon_util.show(...)
    local params = table.pack(...)

	if type_util.is_table(params[2]) then
		return show_emoticon_by_param(params[1], params[2])
	elseif type_util.is_string(params[2]) then
		return show_emoticon_by_param(params[1], {
			type = emoticon_type.item,
			custom_sprite = params[2]
		})
	else
		return stage.EmoticonManager:ShowOn(params[1], params[2])
	end
end

function emoticon_util.show_async(...)
    emoticon_util.show(...)

	wait_for_sec(2.5)
end

---@param token EmoticonAccessToken
function emoticon_util.remove_emoticon(token)
    stage.EmoticonManager:RemoveEmoticon(token)
end

return {
    create = function()
        return emoticon_util
    end
}

---@field parameters nil|any[] 스트링의 placeholder에 채울 파라미터 배열

---@param data ShowNarrationAsyncInfo
function field_ui_util.show_narration_async(data)
	local key = lua_helper.get_value(data, "key", "")
	local type_speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, "typespeed", 0)
	local min_total_duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'mintotalduration', 0)
	local stop_timer = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'stop_timer', false)
	local string_params = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'parameters')

	local text
	if type_util.is_array(string_params) then
		text = game_string:FormatWithReservedKeywords(key, table.unpack(string_params))
	else
		text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key)
	end

	-- 나레이션이 출려되는동안 타이머가 멈춰야한다면 멈춤.
	if stop_timer then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRequestPauseEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	end

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "SetNarration",
			text, type_speed, min_total_duration)

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")

	-- 타이머를 멈췄었다면 타이머 재개
	if stop_timer then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRequestResumeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	end
end

---@param current_alignment number 현재 성향치
---@param current_fame number 현재 명성
---@param alignment_diff number 성향치 변화량
---@param fame_diff number 명성 변화량
function field_ui_util.play_fame_alignment_async(current_alignment, current_fame, alignment_diff, fame_diff)
	local play_over = false
	local end_cb = function()
		play_over = true
	end
	stage.FieldUIFameAlignment:PlayFameAlignment(current_alignment, current_fame, alignment_diff, fame_diff, end_cb)

	while not play_over do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

field_ui_util.play_quest_complete = function(quest_spec, quest_progress)
	local complete = false
	local display_items = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IItem)

	local common_rewards = quest_spec.CommonRewards
	for i = 0, common_rewards.Count - 1 do
		local quest_reward = common_rewards[i]
		local item_place_holder = quest_reward.Item

		if item_place_holder ~= nil then
			local item = nil

			if CS.Oak.ItemSpecId.IsAsset(item_place_holder.ItemId) then
				item = CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(item_place_holder.ItemId), nil, nil, nil, item_place_holder.Amount)
			else
				item = CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(item_place_holder.ItemId), nil, nil, item_place_holder.Level, item_place_holder.Amount)
			end

			display_items:Add(item)
		end
	end

	stage.FieldUIQuestComplete:PlayQuestComplete(quest_progress, function()
		complete = true
	end, display_items)

	while not complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	-- 나레이션이 출려되는동안 타이머가 멈춰야한다면 멈춤.

	local width = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'width', 100)
	local min = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'min', 0)
	local max = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'max', 1)
	local value = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'value', 1)
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 0)

	-- Field UI Hide 여부로 Init 여부를 선택한다.
	local default_init = field_ui_manager.gameObject.activeSelf

	--사용자 지정 need_init이 있을 경우 덮어 씌운다.
	local need_init = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'need_init', default_init)

	local ui_dic = field_ui_util.set_ui(fo, field_ui_type.timer_bar, need_init)
	local time_bar = ui_dic[field_ui_type.timer_bar]

	time_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(width)
	time_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(min, max)
	time_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(value, duration)

	return time_bar

function field_ui_util.show_target_ui(data)
	local hide_default_single_ui = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'hide_default_single_ui', true)
	local show_target = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'show_target', nil)
	local show_minimap = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'show_minimap', false)
	local show_navigation_bar = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'show_navigation_bar', false)
	local show_ui_quest_marker = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'show_ui_quest_marker', false)
	local owner = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'owner', nil)

	if hide_default_single_ui then
		field_ui_util.hide_default_single_ui()
	end

	if show_target ~= nil then
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(show_target, owner)
	end

	if show_minimap then
		stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	end

	if show_navigation_bar and CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	end

	if show_ui_quest_marker then
		ui_quest_marker:Show(true)
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return field_ui_util
	end
}

function gamepad_util.set_tap_game_pad_event(handler, callback_key)
	callback_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(callback_key, 'gamepad_tap_callback')

	if not CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		return
	end

	if handler[callback_key] == nil then
		handler[callback_key] = function(_, e)
			if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))

				return true
			end

			return false
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), callback_key)
	end
end

--- gamepad_util.set_tap_game_pad_event 사용 시 구독 해제를 위해 사용
function gamepad_util.remove_tap_game_pad_event(handler, callback_key)
	callback_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(callback_key, 'gamepad_tap_callback')

	if handler[callback_key] then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		handler[callback_key] = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return gamepad_util
	end
}

	if spec_names == nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('spec names should not be nil')
		return
	end

	local loaders = {}
	for mapping_name, spec_name in pairs(spec_names) do
		local spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetByName(spec_name)
		if spec ~= nil then
			loaders[mapping_name] = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('can not found ' .. spec_name .. ' in npcs sheet')
		end
	end

	-- 캐릭터들 로드 대기
	local load_routines = {}
	table_util.for_each(loaders, function (_, loader) table.insert(load_routines, loader) end)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_all(table.unpack(load_routines)))

	-- 캐릭터들 최소 세팅 시켜준 후에 배열에 담음
	local ret = {}
	table_util.for_each(loaders, function (name, loader)
		local character = loader.Character
		character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		character.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour()
		character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance -- NPC 상호작용체로 바꿔야할수도있음.
		character.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

		-- 레벨을 스테이지 스탠다드 레벨로 맞춰줌.
		local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
		local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
		local stage_level = stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId).StageStandardLevel
		local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, stage_level)
		character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)

		local changed_weapon = false
		--디폴트 무기 설정
		if character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
			character_util.set_equipment(character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)

			changed_weapon = true
		end

		if character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
			character_util.set_equipment(character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)

			changed_weapon = true
		end

		-- UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions 함수 내부에서 최소 3프레임씩은 잡아먹는다. 무기가 장착됐을 때만 업데이트 해주자.
		if changed_weapon then
			-- 배틀 스타일 등 세팅을 위하여 호출
			coroutine.yield(character:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())

			-- 기본 Idle상태로 변경
			-- FieldObjectBehaviour세팅 시 Idle상태로 변경해주지만 이때는 BattleStyle이 없어 CustomAnimation을 세팅하지 못한 상태
			-- 그렇기때문에 다시 한 번 Idle상태로 변경해준다.
			local idle_state = CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState.Create(character)
			message_system:SendSync(character, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(idle_state))
		end

		ret[name] = character
	end)

	return ret
end

--- 타임라인 등에서 GetCharacter으로 동적 할당된 NPC들을 들고 와야되는 경우가 생겨서 기존 로직과 다르게 제작
--- <주의> 핸들네임이 겹치는 NPC가 있으면 안됨!!! 또한 이 함수를 통해 생성한 NPC들은 get_character하지 않도록 해야 함
--- @param spec_names table key: CharacterManager에 등록할 핸들네임 / value: NPC시트에 있는 캐릭터 스펙 명
--- @return table key: 캐릭터 핸들네임 / value: 캐릭터
function load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_names)
	if spec_names == nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('spec names should not be nil')
		return
	end

	local loaders = {}
	for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(spec_names) do
		local spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetByName(spec_name)
		if spec ~= nil then
			loaders[npc_name] = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('can not found ' .. spec_name .. ' in npcs sheet')
		end
	end

	-- 레벨을 스테이지 스탠다드 레벨로 맞춰주기 위해 타겟 경험치 가져옴
	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local stage_level = stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId).StageStandardLevel
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, stage_level)

	local load_routines = {}

	-- 캐릭터들 최소 세팅 시켜준 후에 배열에 담음
	local ret = {}

	table_util.for_each(loaders, function(name, loader)
		table.insert(load_routines, util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 캐릭터 로더로 먼저 로드해줌
			coroutine.yield(loader)

			local character = loader.Character
			character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
			character.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour()
			character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
			character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			character.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

			-- CharacterManager에 등록할 때 이름을 Key로 하기 때문에 GetCharacter할 수 있도록 세팅함
			character.Name = name
			-- CharacterManager에 등록할 때 EntityGroup이 None이면 일부 저장 로직이 무시되기 때문에 기본 NPC EntityGroup으로 맞춰줌
			character.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0

			character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)

			local changed_weapon = false
			--디폴트 무기 설정
			if character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
				character_util.set_equipment(character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,

			if changed_weapon then
				-- 배틀 스타일 등 세팅
				yield_return_func(character.UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions, character)

				-- FieldObjectBehaviour세팅 시 Idle상태로 변경해주지만 이때는 BattleStyle이 없어 CustomAnimation을 세팅하지 못한 상태

	-- 기존에는 무기 세팅할 때 직렬로 돌려서 3프레임씩 잡아먹었기 때문에 무기를 든 NPC가 많아지면 로드 시간이 NPC 개수만큼 증가함
	-- WaitAll을 사용해 병렬로 세팅하도록 해서 로드 시간을 단축함
	wait_all(load_routines)

--- 동적 로딩 캐릭터에 공통 Prefix 부여
---@param prefix string CharacterManager에 등록될 캐릭터 이름의 공통 Prefix
---@param spec_names table<string, string> 생성할 캐릭터 Name -> SpecName
---@return table<string, Character> 키는 spec_names의 키를 그대로 사용함
function load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async(prefix, spec_names)
	local specs = {}

	-- 다이나믹 NPC임을 prefix로 명시함
	prefix = 'dynamic_' .. prefix

	-- CharacterManager에는 Prefix가 붙은 상태로 등록
	for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(spec_names) do
		specs[prefix .. npc_name] = spec_name
	end

	local npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(specs)
	local result = {}
	local sub_start_index = #prefix + 1

	-- 결과물은 Prefix를 뺀 상태로 가져옴
	for npc_name, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		local key = string.sub(npc_name, sub_start_index)

		result[key] = npc
	end

	return result
end

--- 동적 로딩된 캐릭터들의 메모리를 해제해주는 함수

	if npcs == nil then return end

	for _, character in pairs(npcs) do
		-- 캐릭터를 필드 파티션에서 제거
		character.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		-- CharacterManager.characters에는 Neutral Entity로 등록되어있기 때문에, 지울 때도 맞춰줌
		character.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0

		-- CharacterManager에 저장된 데이터 날림
		character_manager:UnRegisterCharacter(character)

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(character.gameObject)
	end
end

	if data_path == nil or data_key == nil then

	local constants = require(data_path)
