function load_util.load_texture_byte(bundle_path, asset_name, parent_obj, sorting_order)
	local asset_bundle
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance.LoadAssetBundleAsync,
			CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance, bundle_path, function(res)
				asset_bundle = res
			end)

	yield_return_func(asset_bundle.LoadAssetAsync, asset_bundle, asset_name, function(texture_bytes)
		if texture_bytes then
			local texture = CS.UnityEngine.Texture2D(2, 2, CS.UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false)
			texture.wrapMode = CS.UnityEngine.TextureWrapMode.Mirror
			if CS.UnityEngine.ImageConversion.LoadImage(texture, texture_bytes.bytes, true) then
				local rect = CS.UnityEngine.Rect(0, 0, texture.width, texture.height)
				-- 텍스쳐를 스프라이트로 생성
				local sprite = CS.UnityEngine.Sprite.Create(texture,
						rect,
						vector(0.5, 0.5),
						100,
						0,
						CS.UnityEngine.SpriteMeshType.Tight,
						unity_class.vector4.zero,
						false)

				-- 새 오브젝트를 만들어서 SpriteRenderer를 붙여줌
				local sprite_renderer = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(parent_obj,
						typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

				if sprite_renderer then
					sprite_renderer.sprite = sprite
					sprite_renderer.sortingOrder = sorting_order
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

    if table[key] ~= nil then return transform_func(table[key]) end
    return nil
end

lua_helper.call_nullable = function(object, function_name, ...)
    if object == nil or object[function_name] == nil then return end
    local args = {...}
    local func = object[function_name]
    return func(table.unpack(args))
end

lua_helper.reference_equals = function(a, b)
    return CS.System.Object.ReferenceEquals(a, b)
end

--- interface 는 namespace 까지 포함
lua_helper.call_interface = function(target, interface, function_name, ...)
    if target == nil then return end
    xlua.private_accessible(target:GetType())
    local args = {...}
    local func = target[function_name]
    if func == nil then
        local private_impl_name = string.format('%s.%s', interface, function_name)
        func = target[private_impl_name]
    end
    if func ~= nil then
        return func(target, table.unpack(args))
    end
    return nil
end

lua_helper.type_compare = function(target, type)
    if target == nil or type == nil then return false end
    return CS.Oak.LuaScriptQuestUtil.CheckType(target, typeof(type))
end

---@param conditional boolean
lua_helper.get_conditional_value = function(conditional, v1, v2)
    if conditional then
        return v1
    else
        return v2
    end
end

return {
    create = function()
        return lua_helper
    end
}

function move_util.move_to_routine(fo, target, data)
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local target_pos = target

	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 1)
	local speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'speed')
	local auto_dir = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'auto_dir')
	local anim = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'anim', 'walk')
	local play_sfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'play_sfx')
	local interpolation = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'interpolation')

	local final_duration = duration
	if speed ~= nil then
		final_duration = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
	end

	if auto_dir ~= nil then
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(target_pos - start_pos)
		if dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			fo.Direction = dir
		end
	end

	if anim ~= nil and type_util.is_character(fo) then
		character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = anim})
	end

	local dash_sfx CS.Oak.AudioSourceHolder()

	if play_sfx ~= nil then
		local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
		if type(play_sfx) == "string" then
			sfx_info.sfxName = play_sfx
		else
			sfx_info.sfxName = "01_dash_01"
		end
		sfx_info.parent = fo
		sfx_info.loop = true
		sfx_info.maxDistance = 10
		sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop
		sfx_info.CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriorityExtensions.GetPlayerType(fo)

		dash_sfx = music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	end

	local interpolation_func = lua_helper.get_or_default(interpolations_constants[interpolation], CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local time_passed = 0

	while true do

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolation_func(time_passed, 0, 1, final_duration)

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = target_pos

	if dash_sfx ~= nil then
		dash_sfx:FadeOut(CS.Oak.SfxConstants.QuickFadeOutDuration)
	end

	if anim ~= nil and type_util.is_character(fo) then
		character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	end
end

--- data {
--- duration: number
--- move_infos : array
--- each_move_info : { target, start_pos, target_pos }
function move_util.move_targets_to(data)
	local duration = data.duration
	local time_passed = 0
	local move_infos = data.move_infos
	local move_info_count = #move_infos
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		for i = 1, move_info_count do
			local mi = move_infos[i]
			mi.target.Position = mi.start_pos * (1 - progress) + mi.target_pos * progress
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

return {
	create = function()
		return move_util
	end
}

	end

	local parsed_bgm_state = music_player_util.parse_stage_bgm_state(state)

	-- state가 유효하지 않으면 수행하지 않음

	music_player:ChangeStageMusicVolume(parsed_bgm_state, volume, duration)

	local bgm_name = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'bgm_name', nil)
	local volume = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'volume', nil)
	local mix = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'mix', nil)
	local is_equal_gain = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'is_equal_gain', nil)
	local fade_out_interpolation = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'fade_out_interpolation', nil)
	local fade_in_interpolation = lua_helper.get_value(param, 'fade_in_interpolation', nil)

	-- state가 nil이면 수행하지 않음
	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(state) then
		return
	end
	
	local parsed_bgm_state = music_player_util.parse_stage_bgm_state(state)
	

	local trans_param = nil

	else

	end
	

	-- state가 유효하지 않으면 수행하지 않음

	end

local function find_op(self, target, name)
	local function generate(c)
		return {
			character = c,
			run = false,
			walk_speed = -1,
			run_speed = -1,
			speed = -1
		}
	end
	if name == 'player' then
		self[target] = generate(user_party_leader)
	elseif name == 'players' then
		local loop_count = user_party.Count
		local players = {}
		for i = 0, loop_count-1 do
			local party_member = user_party[i]
			local target_name = string.format('$player%d', i + 1)
			local sc_character = generate(party_member)
			self[target_name] = sc_character
			table.insert(players, sc_character)
		end
		self[target] = players
	else
		local found = get_character(name)

		if found == nil then
			found = get_field_object(name)
		end

		self[target] = generate(found)
	end
	return
end

local function set_op(self, target, data)
	local data_type = type(data)
	if data_type == 'number' then
		self[target] = data
	elseif data_type == 'boolean' then
		self[target] = data
	elseif data_type == 'string' then
		if string_helper.start_with(data, '$') then
			local cur_obj = self[data]
			if cur_obj ~= nil then
				local cur_obj_type = type(cur_obj)
				if cur_obj_type == 'number' then
					self[target] = cur_obj
				elseif type_util.is_character(cur_obj) then
					local character = cur_obj.character
					self[target] = character.Position
				elseif cur_obj_type == type(unity_class.vector3) then
					self[target] = cur_obj
				end
			end
		else
			self[target] = data
		end
	else
		if type(data[1]) == 'number' then
			self[target] = vector(data[1], data[2], data[3])
		else
			local target_obj = self[target]

			if target_obj == nil or type_util.is_array(target_obj) == false then
				target_obj = {}
			end

			local loop_count = #data
			for i=1, loop_count do
				local name = data[i]
				local cur_obj = self[name]

				if cur_obj ~= nil then
					table.insert(target_obj, cur_obj)
				end
			end

			self[target] = target_obj
		end
	end
end

local function run_op(self, target, enable)
	local check_target, sc_character, character = opration_util.target_check(self, target)
	if check_target == false then return end

	sc_character.run = enable == 'on' and true or false
	sc_character.speed = sc_character.run == true and sc_character.run_speed or sc_character.walk_speed
end

local function speed_op(self, target, data)
	local check_target, sc_character, character = opration_util.target_check(self, target)
	if check_target == false then return end

	if type_util.is_array(data) then
		sc_character.walk_speed = data[1]
		sc_character.run_speed = data[2]
	elseif type(data) == 'number' then
		sc_character.walk_speed = data[1]
		sc_character.run_speed = 0
	elseif data == 'reset' then
		sc_character.walk_speed = -1
		sc_character.run_speed = -1
	else
	end

	sc_character.speed = sc_character.run == true and sc_character.run_speed or sc_character.walk_speed
end
local function play_sfx_op(self, sfx_setting)

	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	if sfx_setting.duration > 0 then
		sfx_info.sfxName = sfx_setting.name
		sfx_info.volume = sfx_setting.volume
		sfx_info.pitch = sfx_setting.pitch
		sfx_info.fadeInTime = sfx_setting.fade_in_time
		sfx_info.fadeOutTime = sfx_setting.fade_out_time
		sfx_info.duration = sfx_setting.duration
		sfx_info.loop = sfx_setting.loop

		if sfx_setting.parent ~= nil then
			sfx_info.parent = get_character(sfx_setting.parent)
		end

		if sfx_setting.loop then
			sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop
		else
			sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Default
		end

		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	elseif sfx_setting.loop or sfx_setting.stoppable then
		sfx_info.sfxName = sfx_setting.name
		sfx_info.volume = sfx_setting.volume
		sfx_info.pitch = sfx_setting.pitch
		sfx_info.loop = sfx_setting.loop
		sfx_info.fadeInTime = sfx_setting.fade_in_time

		if sfx_setting.parent ~= nil then
			sfx_info.parent = get_character(sfx_setting.parent)
		end

		if sfx_setting.loop then
			sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Loop
		else
			sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Default
		end

		local audio_source_holder = CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		self[sfx_setting.name] = audio_source_holder
	elseif sfx_setting.pitch ~= 1 or sfx_setting.fade_in_time ~= 0 then
		sfx_info.sfxName = sfx_setting.name
		sfx_info.volume = sfx_setting.volume
		sfx_info.pitch = sfx_setting.pitch
		sfx_info.fadeInTime = sfx_setting.fade_in_time
		sfx_info.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Default

		if sfx_setting.parent ~= nil then
			sfx_info.parent = get_character(sfx_setting.parent)
		end

		CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	else
		if sfx_setting.parent ~= nil then
			sfx_info.sfxName = sfx_setting.name
			sfx_info.volume = sfx_setting.volume
			sfx_info.parent = get_character(sfx_setting.parent)

			CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
		else
			CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfxOneShot(sfx_setting.name, sfx_setting.volume)
		end
	end
end

	if dir_name == 'lock' then
		character:SetLockedDirection(character, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(
				character.Direction, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))
	elseif dir_name == 'unlock' then
		character:RemoveLockedDirection(character)
	elseif string_helper.start_with(dir_name, '$') then
		local target_name = string.gsub(dir_name, '$', '')

		local diff = dir_target.character.Position - character.Position
		character.Direction = diff:ToDirection()

		character.Direction = dir
	end

--- @param (...) 이안에는 func, args 를 넣어서 coroutine 만들어서 동시에 돌린다
local function do_op(...)
	local params = {...}
	local count = #params
	local player_count = 1

	local ops = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		local op = params[i]
		local args = op.args

		if op.func ~= find_op then
			--characters가 복수일 경우 기존 target.name의 string을 넘기지만 character를 넘길 수 있도록 변경
			local characters = lua_helper.get_value(args[1], args[2])
			local is_characters = false

			if characters ~= nil and type(characters) == 'table' and type_util.is_array(characters) then
				is_characters = true
			end

			if is_characters then
				player_count = #characters
				if player_count == 1 and count == 1 then
					params[1].args[2] = characters[1]
				else
					for j = 1, player_count do
						local new_args = {table.unpack(args)}
						new_args[2] = characters[j]

						local cs = util.cs_generator(op.func, table.unpack(new_args))
						table.insert(ops, cs)
					end
				end
			else
				local cs = util.cs_generator(op.func, table.unpack(args))
				table.insert(ops, cs)
			end
		else
			local cs = util.cs_generator(op.func, table.unpack(args))
			table.insert(ops, cs)
		end
	end


	local ops_count = #ops

	if ops_count == 0 then
		local cs = util.cs_generator(params[1].func, table.unpack(params[1].args))
		table.insert(ops, cs)
	end

	ops_count = #ops


	if ops_count == 1 then
		local co = coroutine_class.coroutine(ops[1])
		-- HACK: 우리 코루틴은 던지면 바로 실행 시켜야 되므로 여기서 실행
		-- 바로 한번 실행
		-- co:MoveNext()
		coroutine.yield(co)
		return
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_all(table.unpack(ops)))
end

--- @param (...) 이안에는 func, args 를 넣어서 순차적으로 돌린다
local function sequence_op(...)
	local params = {...}
	local count = #params

	local ops = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		local op = params[i]
		local args = op.args

		if op.func ~= find_op then
			if args[2] == '$players' then
				local players = lua_helper.get_value(args[1], args[2])

				for j = 1, #players do
					local new_args = {table.unpack(args)}
					new_args[2] = string.format('$player%d', j)

					local cs = util.cs_generator(op.func, table.unpack(new_args))
					table.insert(ops, cs)
				end
			else
				local cs = util.cs_generator(op.func, table.unpack(args))
				table.insert(ops, cs)
			end
		else
			local cs = util.cs_generator(op.func, table.unpack(args))
			table.insert(ops, cs)
		end
	end

	--FIXME : 정리 필요
	-- Count == 1인 상황에서 분리가 필요하지 않아 보이는데?
	if count == 1 and player_count == 1 then
		coroutine.yield(params[1].func(table.unpack(params[1].args)))
	else
		for i = 1, #ops do
			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.coroutine(ops[i]))
		end
	end
end

local function position_op(self, target, data)
	local check_target, sc_character, character = opration_util.target_check(self, target)
	if check_target == false then return end

	local point_name
	local to
	local flying
	local pos

	if type(data) == 'table' then
		if data[1] ~= nil then  -- Array Check
			pos = vector(data[1], data[2], data[3])
		else
			to = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')
			flying = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'flying')

			if type(to) == 'table' then
				point_name = to
			else
				pos = vector(data[1], data[2], data[3])
			end
		end
	else
		point_name = data
	end

	if point_name ~= nil then
		local point_obj = lua_helper.get_value(self, point_name).character

		if point_obj ~= nil then
			pos = point_obj.Position
		end
	end
	if typeof(character) == typeof(CS.Oak.Character) then
		if flying ~= nil and flying == false then
			character.Position = pos
		else
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.SetPosition(character, pos, true)
		end
	else
		character.Position = pos
	end
end

local function move_op(self, target, data)
	local check_target, sc_character, character = opration_util.target_check(self, target)
	if check_target == false then return end

	local character_pos = character.Position

	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', -1)
	local direction = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'direction', 'null')
	local speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'speed', -1)
	local wait = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'wait', true)
	local patrol = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'patrol', false)
	local play_sfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'play_sfx', false)
	local keep_animation = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'keep_animation', false)
	local obj_distance = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'obj_distance', 0)

	local y_mode = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'ymode')
	local cs_y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free
	if y_mode ~= nil then
		if y_mode == 'floor' then
			cs_y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Floor
		elseif y_mode == 'flying' then
			cs_y_mode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
		end
	end

	local offset = lua_helper.transform_value(data, 'offset',
			function(val)
				if type_util.is_array(val) == true then
					return vector(val[1], val[2], val[3])
				end
				return nil
			end)
	local to = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')

	local target_pos
	local points = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	if type_util.is_array(to) then
		if type(to[1]) == 'number' then
			target_pos = vector(to[1], to[2], to[3])
			points:Add(target_pos)
		else
			local loop = #to
			for i=1, loop do
				local inner_point = to[i]
				points:Add(vector(inner_point[1], inner_point[2], inner_point[3]))
			end
		end
	elseif offset ~= nil then
		if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(to) then
			target_pos = character_pos + offset
		else
			target_pos = self[to].character.Position + offset
		end
		points:Add(target_pos)
	else
		local sc_target = self[to]
		local pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
		if sc_target['character'] ~= nil then
			pos = sc_target.character.Position
			local minus_pos = unity_class.vector3.Normalize(pos - character_pos) * obj_distance
			pos = pos - minus_pos
		else
			pos = sc_target
		end
		points:Add(pos)
	end

	if keep_animation == false then
		character:RemoveAnimation()
	end

	local point_count = points.Count

	if speed < 0 and duration > 0 then
		if point_count == 1 then
			local distance = unity_class.mathf.Abs((character_pos - points[0]).magnitude)
			speed = distance / duration
		else
			local distance = 0
			local cur_pos = character_pos
			for i = 0, point_count - 1 do
				distance = distance + unity_class.mathf.Abs((cur_pos - points[i]).magnitude)
				cur_pos = points[i]
			end

			speed = distance / duration
		end
	elseif speed < 0 then
		speed = sc_character.speed
	end

	local move_info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()

	move_info.waypoints = points
	move_info.speed = speed
	move_info.lastDirection = patrol == true and CS.Oak.Direction.None or CS.StringExtensions.StringToDir(direction)
	move_info.run = sc_character.run
	move_info.endType = patrol == false and CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Stop or CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Loop
	move_info.yMode = cs_y_mode
	move_info.playSfx = play_sfx

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(character, move_info)

	if cs_y_mode == CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying then
		while character.Position ~= points[point_count - 1] and patrol == false and wait == true do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	else
		while character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped and
				patrol == false and
				wait == true do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

		name = data
		repeat_val = true
		scale = 1
		upper = false

		sfx_key = nil

		sfx_handler = CS.Oak.LuaScriptOperationHelper.KeyframeSoundPlayDelegate(character, sfx_key, sfx_name)
	end

		local anim_request =
		CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(
				name, CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, repeat_val, scale, -1, nil, sfx_handler, nil)

	else

	end

	if wait and sc_character ~= nil then
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(character.SpineController, name)))
	end

	return

local function focus_camera_op(self, data)
	local camera_mode = 'lock'
	local duration, pos, wait, ignore_grid, lock_on
	local end_target
	local option
	if type_util.is_string(data) then
		camera_mode = data
	else
		duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration')
		wait = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'wait', true)
		ignore_grid = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'ignore_grid', false)
		lock_on = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'lock_on', false)

		local pos_obj = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'position')

		if type_util.is_array(pos_obj) then
			pos = vector(pos_obj[1], pos_obj[2], pos_obj[3])
		else
			if pos_obj == 'reset' then
				option = pos_obj
				pos = user_party_leader.Position
			else
				local sc = self[pos_obj]
				if lock_on then
					end_target = sc.character
				else
					end_target = nil
				end

				pos = sc.character.Position
			end
		end
	end

	if camera_mode == 'lock' then
		stage_camera:Move(pos, duration, end_target, ignore_grid)
	elseif camera_mode == 'unlock' then
		stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party)
		return
	else
		stage_camera:CancelMove()
		return
	end

	if wait == true then
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(duration))
	end

	if option ~= nil and option == 'reset' then
		if camera_mode == 'lock' and wait == true then
			stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party)
		elseif camera_mode == 'lock' then

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(duration))
			stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party)
		end
	end
	return
end

local function position_party_op(self, data)
	local to = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')
	local direction = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'direction')
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type')
	local party_count = user_party.Count
	local pos_list, target_pos, dir_list
	local target_name

	if type_util.is_array(to) then
		local to_count = #to
		if to_count == 3 and type_util.is_number(to[1]) == true then
			target_pos = vector(to[1], to[2], to[3])
		else
			pos_list = {}
			for i=1, to_count do
				if type_util.is_array(to[i]) == true then
					local cur_list = to[i]
					table.insert(pos_list, vector(cur_list[1], cur_list[2], cur_list[3]))
				end
			end
		end
	elseif type_util.is_string(to) then
		target_name = to
	end

	dir_list = {}
	if type_util.is_array(direction) then
		local count = #direction
		for i=1, count do
			table.insert(dir_list, direction[i])
		end
	elseif type_util.is_string(direction) then

		for i=1, party_count do
			table.insert(dir_list, CS.StringExtensions.StringToDir(direction))
		end
	end

	if pos_list == nil then
		pos_list = {}
		local is_arc = (type ~= nil and type_util.is_string(type) == true and type == 'arc')
		local base_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(dir_list[1]))
		local quaternion = unity_class.quaternion
		local vector3 = unity_class.vector3
		table.insert(pos_list, target_pos)

		if is_arc == true then
			if party_count == 2 then
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + base_dir * constants.dist_between_party_members)
			elseif party_count == 3 then
				local angle = 90
				local dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * constants.dist_between_party_members)
				dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * constants.dist_between_party_members)
			elseif party_count == 4 then
				local angle = 120
				local dist = constants.dist_between_party_members * 1.25
				local dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * dist)
				dir = base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * dist)
				dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * dist)
			end
		else
			for i = 1, party_count do
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + base_dir * i * constants.dist_between_party_members)
			end
		end
	end

	for i=1, party_count do
		local unity_index = i - 1
		if target_name ~= nil then

			local sc = self[target_name]
			if target.character ~= nil then
				target_pos = sc.character.Position
			else
				target_pos = sc
			end

			pos_list[i] = pos_list[i] + target_pos
		end

		CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.SetPosition(user_party[unity_index], pos_list[i])
		user_party[unity_index].Direction = dir_list[i]
	end
end

local function sns_op(data)
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type', 'default')
	local id = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'id')
	local text = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'code')

	local follower_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('FollowerData')
	local spec = follower_data:GetSpec(id)

	local target_name = spec.Name
	local portrait_name = spec.PortraitName
	local sns_obj

	if type == 'follow' then
		-- FIXME: AddSnSRoutine이랑 똑같이해놓긴했지만 나중에는 C#의 AddSNSRoutine을 가져다 쓰는것이 좋아보임.
		if not user_progress.Followers:Contains(id) then
			local req = CS.Oak.StageApiRouter.SendAddFollower(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageId, id)

			if req ~= nil then
				coroutine.yield(req)

				if req.Ok == false then
					return
				end
			end

			user_progress:AddFollower(id)
		end

		local str = game_string:Format('sns_follow', game_string:GetString(target_name))
		sns_obj = CS.Oak.SNSMessage.Create(target_name, portrait_name, str)
	else
		sns_obj = CS.Oak.SNSMessage.Create(target_name, portrait_name, game_string:GetString(text))
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSEvent.Create(sns_obj))

	local sns_popped = false

	local event_receiver = {}
	event_receiver.on_sns_poped = function(e)
		sns_popped = true
		return false
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_receiver, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent), "on_sns_poped")

	local time_passed = 0

	while sns_popped == false and time_passed < 1.75 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if sns_popped == false then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSPopEvent.Instance)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_receiver, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent))
	event_receiver = nil
end

local function move_party_op(self, data)
	local to = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')
	local speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'speed')
	local direction = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'direction')
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type')
	local wait =lua_helper.get_value(data, 'wait', true)
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration')
	local party_count = user_party.Count
	local pos_list, target_pos, dir_list, speed_list, duration_list
	local target_name

	if type_util.is_array(to) then
		local to_count = #to
		if to_count == 3 and type_util.is_number(to[1]) == true then
			target_pos = vector(to[1], to[2], to[3])
		else
			pos_list = {}
			for i=1, to_count do
				if type_util.is_array(to[i]) == true then
					local cur_list = to[i]
					table.insert(pos_list, vector(cur_list[1], cur_list[2], cur_list[3]))
				end
			end
		end
	elseif type_util.is_string(to) then
		target_name = to
	end

	if type_util.is_array(speed) then
		speed_list = {}
		local count = #speed
		for i=1, count do
			table.insert(speed_list, speed[i])
		end
	elseif type_util.is_number(speed) then
		speed_list = {}
		for i=1, party_count do
			table.insert(speed_list, speed)
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_array(duration) then
		duration_list = {}
		local count = #duration
		for i=1, count do
			table.insert(duration_list, duration[i])
		end
	elseif type_util.is_number(duration) then
		duration_list = {}
		for i=1, party_count do
			table.insert(duration_list, duration)
		end
	end

	dir_list = {}
	if type_util.is_array(direction) then
		local count = #direction
		for i=1, count do
			table.insert(dir_list, direction[i])
		end
	elseif type_util.is_string(direction) then

		for i=1, party_count do
			table.insert(dir_list, CS.StringExtensions.StringToDir(direction))
		end
	end

	if pos_list == nil then
		pos_list = {}
		local is_arc = (type ~= nil and type_util.is_string(type) == true and type == 'arc')
		local dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(dir_list[1])
		local base_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(dir)
		local quaternion = unity_class.quaternion
		local vector3 = unity_class.vector3
		table.insert(pos_list, target_pos)

		if is_arc == true then
			if party_count == 2 then
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + base_dir * constants.dist_between_party_members)
			elseif party_count == 3 then
				local angle = 90
				local dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * constants.dist_between_party_members)
				dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * constants.dist_between_party_members)
			elseif party_count == 4 then
				local angle = 120
				local dist = constants.dist_between_party_members * 1.25
				local dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(-angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * dist)
				dir = base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * dist)
				dir = quaternion.AngleAxis(angle * 0.5, vector3.up) * base_dir
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + dir * dist)
			end
		else
			for i = 1, party_count do
				table.insert(pos_list, target_pos + base_dir * i * constants.dist_between_party_members)
			end
		end
	end

	local operation_count = math.min(#pos_list, party_count)

	for i = 1, operation_count do
		if target_name ~= nil then

			local sc = self[target_name]
			if target.character ~= nil then
				target_pos = sc.character.Position
			else
				target_pos = sc
			end

			pos_list[i] = pos_list[i] + target_pos
		end

		local way_points = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		local move_info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo()
		way_points:Add(pos_list[i])

		move_info.lastDirection = dir_list[i]
		move_info.endType = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveEndType.Stop
		move_info.yMode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free
		move_info.waypoints = way_points

		local cur_speed

		if speed_list ~= nil then
			cur_speed = speed_list[i]
		else
			local diff = user_party[i - 1].Position - pos_list[i]
			cur_speed = diff.magnitude / duration_list[i]
		end

		local min_speed = 1
		if cur_speed < min_speed then
			cur_speed = min_speed
		end

		move_info.speed = cur_speed

		CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(user_party[i - 1], move_info)
	end

	if wait == false then return end

	while true do
		local complete_num = 0

		for i = 1, operation_count do
			if user_party[i - 1].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
				complete_num = complete_num + 1
			end
		end

		if complete_num == operation_count then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local function spline_move_op(self, target, data)
	local check_target, sc_character, character = opration_util.target_check(self, target)
	if check_target == false then return end

	local pos_list = lua_helper.transform_value(data, 'to',
			function(value)
				local loop = #value
				local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
				for i = 1, loop do
					local inner = value[i]
					list:Add(vector(inner[1], inner[2], inner[3]))
				end
				return list
			end)
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type', 'normal')
	local direction = lua_helper.transform_value(data, 'direction',
			function(value)
				return CS.StringExtensions.StringToDir(value)
			end)
	local y_mode = lua_helper.transform_value(data, 'ymode',
			function(value)
				if value == 'floor' then
					return CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Floor
				elseif value == 'flying' then
					return CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
				end
				return CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Free

			end)

	local cycle = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'cycle', 0)

	pos_list:Insert(0, character.Position)

	local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()
	local curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear
	local count = #pos_list

	if count == 3 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
	elseif count == 4 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
	end
	calculator:Add(pos_list, cycle, curve_type)
	local motion_path = character.UnityGameObject.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.MotionPath))
	if motion_path == nil then
		motion_path = character.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.MotionPath))
	end

	local way_points = pos_list:ToArray()
	motion_path.controlPoints = way_points
	motion_path:Init()

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) < cycle do

		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / cycle
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero

		if type == 'normal' then
			cur_pos = CS.iTween.PointOnPath(way_points, progress)
		elseif type == 'constant_speed' then
			cur_pos = motion_path:PointOnNormalizedPath(progress)
		elseif type == 'bezier_curve' then
			calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition
		end

		if y_mode == CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying then
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.SetPosition(character, cur_pos, true);
		else
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.SetPosition(character, cur_pos);
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character.Direction = direction
end

function operation_util.target_check(self, target)
    if target == nil then
        return false
    end
    if self[target] == nil and not type_util.is_character(target) then
        return false
    end
    local sc_character = self[target]
    if sc_character == nil then
        sc_character = target
    end

    if character == nil then

--- pooled object 이동 함수
---@param pooled_object PooledUnityObject 이동할 pooled object
---@param pos Vector3 도착 지점 vector3
---@param duration number 도착까지 걸리는 시간
---@param args { interpolation:string|nil } 보간 타입
function pooled_object_util.move_async(pooled_object, pos, duration, args)
	local interpolation = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'interpolation', 'linear')
	local interpolation_func = interpolations_constants[interpolation]

	local start_pos = pooled_object.transform.localPosition

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolation_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		pooled_object.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	pooled_object.transform.localPosition = pos
end

--- pooled object 크기 조정 함수
---@param pooled_object PooledUnityObject 크기를 조정할 pooled object
---@param scale Vector3 조정할 크기 vector3
---@param duration number 걸리는 시간
---@param args { interpolation:string|nil } 보간 타입
function pooled_object_util.scale_async(pooled_object, scale, duration, args)
	local interpolation = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'interpolation', 'linear')
	local interpolation_func = interpolations_constants[interpolation]

	local start_scale = pooled_object.transform.localScale

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolation_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		pooled_object.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_scale, scale, progress)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	pooled_object.transform.localScale = scale
end

--- pooled object 회전 함수
---@param pooled_object PooledUnityObject 회전할 pooled object
---@param target_rotation Vector3 목표 회전 각도 vector3
---@param duration number 걸리는 시간
---@param args { interpolation:string|nil } 보간 타입
function pooled_object_util.rotate_async(pooled_object, target_rotation, duration, args)
	local interpolation = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'interpolation', 'linear')
	local interpolation_func = interpolations_constants[interpolation]

	local start_rotation = pooled_object.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolation_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		local cur_angle = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rotation, target_rotation, progress)
		pooled_object.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_angle)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	pooled_object.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(target_rotation)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return pooled_object_util
	end
}

function purple_coin_util.hide_activated_purple_coins()
	-- 캐싱된 퍼플코인 테이블이 있으면 테이블 순환으로 감추기
	if purple_coin_util.cached_purple_coins ~= nil then

		for i = 1, cached_purple_coins_num do
			local purple_coin = purple_coin_util.cached_purple_coins[i]
			if purple_coin.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				purple_coin.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end
		end
	else -- 캐싱된 퍼플코인 테이블이 없으면 기믹 레이어에서 퍼플코인을 찾아서 감추기
		purple_coin_util.cached_purple_coins = {}

		local gimmick_layer = stage.StageGameObject.transform:Find(stage.Name .. '/gimmick/')
		for i = 0, gimmick_layer.childCount - 1 do
			local purple_coin = gimmick_layer:GetChild(i):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))
			if lua_helper.type_compare(purple_coin.FieldObjectBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.PurpleCoinBehaviour)) then
				if not purple_coin.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden and not stage_progress:HasPurpleCoin(purple_coin.KeyIndex) then
					purple_coin.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
					table.insert(purple_coin_util.cached_purple_coins, purple_coin)
				end
			end

	if purple_coin_util.cached_purple_coins == nil then

	for i = 1, cached_purple_coins_num do

			CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled

	end

			time_util.unmod('qte_mod')
		end

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	if need_process_gamepad then

	end

	if show_tutorial_spine then
		qte_play_util.show_action_tap(field_ui_type, darken, anim_time_scale, anim_unscaled_time)
	else
		if darken then
			field_util.darken('qte_darken', 0.5, 0.1)
		end

	end

	if time_mod ~= nil then
		time_util.mod('qte_mod', time_mod)
	end

	while not wait_check do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if show_tutorial_spine then
		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	else
		if darken then
			field_util.undarken('qte_darken')
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))
	end

		time_util.unmod('qte_mod')
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	return wait_check == true
